jobs.description:
â¡ This one's going to move fast. We're expecting a lot of interest, so we're running this as a focused hiring sprint. Applications and assessments close September 20, with interviews happening over the two weeks after that.Â 

ð Where do we hire from? Almost everywhere. Check that your country appears on this page. For this role, you'll have at least 4 hours daily overlap with your UK-based manager.

Hi there, I'm Olive Turon, Head of People & Culture at TestGorilla. I'm excited to share more about the Senior People & Talent Operations Partner role and our team.

About TestGorilla

At TestGorilla, we're on a mission to place 1 billion people in their dream jobs. To democratize opportunity, we're building the world's leading skills-based talent discovery platform - one that replaces reliance on resumes with scientific validation of what people can truly do.

Founded as a 100% remote company in 2020, our global team is united by high standards, a lot of heart, and a relentless drive to conquer new technological frontiers. We're all AI-fluent builders who care deeply about replacing bias with fairness.

After empowering thousands of companies to hire smarter and faster, we're now unlocking the next phase of our scale-up journey - where you'll play an instrumental role in creating a world where skills matter most!

About the role

As our Senior People & Talent Operations Partner, you'll own People Ops as a product: the systems, compliance, and self-serve workflows that let most of People & Culture run itself day to day, plus the tooling behind how we hire. You'll join a lean, two-person team, working directly with me, with proper and lasting ownership from day one.Â 

Payroll, compliance, and HR systems across every (35, currently!) country we operate in are foundational elements of this role. Just as critically, you'll build and own the AI/automation and self-serve layer that keeps our People function lean, bringing a product mindset to everything you touch.Â  Letâs face it: weâre a scale-up, so youâll also need to be happy wearing other People hats when the moment requires.

We're looking for someone autonomous, opinionated and candid, who'll tell me when I've got it wrong. You'll be dealing with real people and real problems, so you'll need to stay empathic but boundaried, structured and organized even when the pace picks up.

Iâm biased, but I think itâs a dream job: this is an HR role in an HRTech company changing the world of work for the better, weâll have immense amounts of fun, thereâs plenty of uncharted territory for you to make your own, and Iâm committed to helping you to do the best work of your life.

A quick check: if you've never built objectively clever automations (not just used one someone else built), this probably isn't the role for you. Automation is just that central to the job.

Responsibilities

In this role, your responsibilities will include:

  • Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture.

  • Designing, building and maintaining a smart, automated and AI-enabled people journey - from pre-boarding to off-boarding - that frees up capacity for bespoke, white-glove treatment where it matters

  • Being the technical owner and orchestrator of our HR tech stack: evaluating and enhancing it, ensuring these tools are not siloed but unified and integrated.

  • Owning the non-Finance side of payroll, invoicing, contract administration, and compliance end to end, across every country we operate in.

  • Owning data privacy and recordkeeping, and the day-to-day relationship with our EOR vendor.

  • Owning configuration and troubleshooting of our hiring tooling, so hiring managers can run their own searches independently.

  • Owning the documentation that makes self-serve actually work in practice, ensuring that itâs structured in a way that is easily accessible to both humans and P&C AI agents.Â 

  • Working with me to maintain a clean line between what's self-serve and what needs a person. We do not aspire to automate our entire People journey here.Â 

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone who:

  • Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs.

  • Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Has built and owned sophisticated automations (Zapier, n8n, Make.com, and the like) as a core part of an integrated HR tech stack, not just used AI tools day to day. Arguably the most important thing on this list.

  • Has managed payroll, compliance, or HR operations across multiple countries, ideally through an Employer of Record or a mix of EOR and direct entities.

  • Has deep, hands-on HRIS experience. HiBob experience is a big plus, and so is experience assessing or migrating HR systems.

  • Brings a product mindset: builds for the people who use them (employees and managers), listens to their feedback, and iterates rather than building in isolation.

  • Thrives in a high-autonomy, async-first, remote-only environment, and has worked in these kinds of teams and working cultures before.

  • Marries operational rigor with genuine empathy and a real interest in people. You'll be dealing directly with team members, sometimes on sensitive matters.

  • Is opinionated and candid, with excellent feedback and stakeholder management skills.

Most people in this role will have acquired these skills over five years of relevant experience. That being said, we care far more about what you've owned, your impact and how you've progressed, than the exact number of years.

We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone, even if your experience doesn't exactly match the description. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement - let's buck that trend!

Bonus skills

While these skills aren't a requirement, we'd be very interested to hear from you if you have any of the following:

  • Experience with an ATS or hiring platform such as Ashby, Greenhouse, or Lever.

  • Experience with an EOR provider such as Remote, Deel, or Oyster.

  • HRIS implementation or migration project experience.

  • Experience supporting a team through organizational change.

What's in it for you?

Please note: In this role, you'll be hired as an Individual Contractor.

  • Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world.

  • Competitive compensation: â¬56,520 - â¬70,650 base pay + Share Appreciation Rights (SARs). This role doesn't carry a bonus component.

  • Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life.
    *Check out the countries we currently hire from here.

  • Remote work budget: â¬1,000 available each year, or up to â¬2,000 from day 1 if you're buying a laptop!

  • Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget per year and clear growth opportunities.

  • Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches.

  • Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being.

Interested?

At TestGorilla, we believe your skills speak louder than your resume. That's why we champion a skills-first approach, using cutting-edge, AI-powered assessments to uncover your true skills and experience match.

When you apply, you'll get to experience our platform firsthand by taking an assessment â it's your invitation to shine and show us what you can do! While our platform is powered by AI, every hiring decision is made by humans. Check out our Applicant Privacy document to see how we protect your data.

Given the hiring sprint timeline above, we'd love to see your application land before September 20.

Concerned about test anxiety or need help with the assessment? We've got you covered. Please check out our candidate support page for any questions. Accommodations are readily available as part of the assessment setup, and requesting support will never impact your application.

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

    • Week 0: Unpaid

    • Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Post Training Period:

*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

  • Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce.   • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

  • Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

  • Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

jobs.title: Surveyor I
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

jobs.description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.

Position Summary

The Clinical Coordinator Department Manager oversees the Clinical Coordination team responsible for maintaining accurate, appropriately filled provider schedules across all markets. This role provides leadership, operational oversight, training, workload management, process improvement, and cross-department collaboration to support consistent scheduling performance.

This leader sets daily and weekly priorities, delegates work, holds the team accountable, monitors current and upcoming schedule health, and identifies risks before they impact provider days. The manager ensures accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked and that scheduling barriers are tracked and escalated to the appropriate owner.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Performance Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop Clinical Coordinators through clear priorities, delegation, accountability, and follow-through

  • Oversee team scheduling, workload balancing, and coverage across markets based on provider days, appointment volume, and overall workload
  • Support onboarding and competency development for new team members

Appointment Readiness & Schedule Reliability

    • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment

About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Communication

  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

jobs.title: People Partner Lead, Germany & Sweden
jobs.description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Why this role exists

You’ll help build Neko’s clinical organisation in Germany from the ground up, and then lead the people strategy that helps it scale.

Neko’s clinics are where our mission comes to life. The experience members have is shaped by the teams behind it, making the organisation itself one of the most important products we build. In Germany, this organisation doesn’t exist yet. Before the first clinic opens, you’ll help define clinical roles, workforce planning, compensation, and the employee experience that attracts exceptional talent. Then, as clinics launch and grow, you’ll partner with leaders to ensure those teams perform, develop, and scale successfully.

This is a rare opportunity to build an organisation from day one – and to shape what it becomes as Neko brings prevention-first healthcare to another market.

Phase one: build the foundation, pre-launch

  • Ensure the German employment framework is appropriately set up with legal, external counsel, key internal teams, like People Ops and Workforce Planning – contracts, working-time and rostering models, pay structures, policies, payroll and people systems

  • Design the clinic organisation from a blank sheet, and a staffing model sized to Neko’s ambition for the market rather than to the first clinic

  • Own the launch workforce plan, the cover and contracting model, and reward in a German context – pay, pension, equity

  • Build a German clinical employer proposition from zero with TA, and a playbook the next market can reuse

Build for German employment structures from day one

  • Design workforce policies (scheduling, pay, performance) with German labor law and employee representation requirements in mind from the start

  • Work with legal counsel to determine the right structure for German clinic operations

  • Ensure people systems and tools are built to comply with German labor regulations

Phase two: run clinical people strategy live

  • Be the day-to-day People partner across German clinical leadership, from senior operations and medical leaders through to frontline clinic managers

  • Spend real time in clinics, and read what members experience there as signal about how teams are resourced, structured and led – spotting strain, inconsistency or risk early, because it usually shows up in the clinic room before it shows up in the data

  • Coach clinic leaders through hiring, performance and the conversations that are hard but important – and build the leadership capability and multi-way feedback culture that keep employee relations issues from piling up, while supporting teams and leaders through the ones that do

  • Support first-time clinic managers as they build confidence, capability and steady leadership habits

  • Hold the staffing model against the growth plan: German absence, leave and part-time realities, the clinical qualification and mobility pipeline, and honesty when the plan and the labour market disagree

  • Turn central People programmes into clinic-ready practice, and call out where a centralised approach misses frontline reality

  • Revisit what you built pre-launch as clinics run, and put data and AI to work in how the People agenda actually operates – sharper decisions, less manual effort, more time on the judgement calls

  • Take change from decision to genuine adoption, bringing clinic teams with you without pausing delivery to do it

Beyond Germany

  • Help drive the global People Partner team’s clinical strategy rather than just feed into it

  • Bring the German clinical reality into that team's agenda, so decisions made at scale hold up on the ground

  • Support the wider European market as it grows, and other markets as needed

What you bring

  • 8+ years as a senior People or HR Business Partner leader, across senior levels of leadership and frontline leaders of larger teams

  • A builder's mindset – comfortable starting from a blank sheet, having opened or scaled operations in Germany or built a German people function from close to nothing

  • Deep, practical command of German employment law and co-determination, with the judgement to know when to bring in counsel

  • Germany is the core requirement; multi-market European experience is strongly preferred – you have worked across more than one European employment landscape (Sweden a significant plus) and know what scales beyond a single market

  • Has built a staffing model that had to scale on an opening cadence, and has localised reward in Germany – pay, pension, equity

  • Comfortable in both phases – the ambiguity of pre-launch and the discipline of running something live

  • Moves at the pace of the business and leads people through change – you have taken teams through reorganisations, new operating models or rapid scaling, and kept trust and delivery intact while doing it

  • A local delivery mandate and a real seat in cross-market strategy, held at the same time, at pace

  • Fluent with people data and using AI in your own work, and ties people decisions to what members actually experience in the room

  • Fluent German and English, based in Berlin, and ready to spend regular time in clinics

jobs.description:
DEINE ROLLE

Du bist auf Instagram, LinkedIn & Co. zu Hause, hast ein gutes Gespür für Content und kannst selbst starke Posts, Reels und Stories produzieren? Du interessierst dich außerdem für Wirtschaft, Investments und die Welt rund um Vermögen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Als Social Media Manager (m/w/d) unterstützt du uns dabei, unsere Social-Media-Kanäle weiterzuentwickeln – von der ersten Content-Idee über die Produktion bis zur Veröffentlichung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Content-, Brand- und Podcast-Team zusammen und bringst deine eigenen Ideen und dein Gespür für guten Social Content ein.

Von Anfang an übernimmst du Verantwortung für eigene Themen und Formate. Ob Social Posts, Reels, Podcast-Clips oder Event-Content: Du hilfst uns dabei, komplexe Finanz- und Investmentthemen verständlich, relevant und visuell stark für Social Media aufzubereiten.

Was machst du dabei konkret?

  • Social Media & Planung: Du betreust unsere Kanäle auf Instagram, LinkedIn und Facebook und planst gemeinsam mit dem Team, welche Themen und Formate wann und wo stattfinden.

  • Content Creation: Du entwickelst Posts, Carousels, Reels und Stories von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung. Gleichzeitig machst du aus bestehenden Inhalten wie Magazinartikeln, Marktkommentaren, Interviews, Events oder Expertengesprächen eigenständigen Social Content – von starken Hooks und Captions bis zu Recaps und Key Takeaways.

  • Podcast & Video: Du unterstützt bei der Produktion von That’s Smart Money und entwickelst aus unseren Gesprächen relevante Clips und Short-Form-Content. Dabei arbeitest du unter anderem mit Riverside und unseren Video-Tools.

  • Trends & neue Ideen: Du beobachtest, welche Formate und Mechaniken auf Social Media funktionieren, und überlegst, was davon zu LIQID passt. Gute Ideen sollst du bei uns nicht nur vorschlagen, sondern auch ausprobieren können.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Du verstehst Social Media und hast bereits selbst Content gemacht: Ob für einen eigenen Account, ein Projekt, dein Studium oder ein Unternehmen, ist für uns zweitrangig. Entscheidend ist, dass du ein gutes Gespür dafür hast, was auf Social Media funktioniert.

  • Du kannst Geschichten erzählen und richtig gut schreiben: Du erkennst den interessanten Gedanken in einem Thema, findest einen starken Einstieg und kannst auch komplexere Inhalte verständlich und präzise auf den Punkt bringen.

  • Du hast ein gutes visuelles Gespür und Lust auf Produktion: Fotografie, Typografie, Layout und Video interessieren dich und du setzt Content gerne selbst um. Erfahrung mit Riverside, CapCut, Premiere oder ähnlichen Tools ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • Du packst selbst an: Du arbeitest eigenständig und zuverlässig, bringst Ideen mit und hast Lust, Verantwortung für eigene Themen und Formate zu übernehmen.

  • Du bist neugierig auf Finanzthemen: Du musst noch kein Investment-Profi sein. Aber Wirtschaft, Märkte und Investments interessieren dich und du hast Lust, dich auch in komplexere Themen einzuarbeiten.

  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team: Du hast Spaß daran, gemeinsam mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Content, Brand, Podcast und anderen Bereichen aus einer guten Idee richtig guten Content zu machen.

So geht es für dich weiter

Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte – und geben dir gleichzeitig die Möglichkeit, LIQID und das Team kennenzulernen.

  • Erstes virtuelles Kennenlernen mit unserer Social Media Managerin Verena: Wir tauschen uns darüber aus, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen.

  • Kleine praktische Aufgabe: Du bekommst eine Aufgabe, die sich an typischen Themen aus deinem zukünftigen Arbeitsalltag orientiert. So sehen wir, wie du Content denkst und umsetzt – und du bekommst einen konkreten Eindruck von der Rolle.

  • Gespräch mit unserer Hiring Managerin Lenika & Team: Wir tauchen tiefer in die Rolle ein, sprechen über deine bisherigen Erfahrungen und geben dir einen Einblick in unsere Content- und Social-Media-Arbeit.

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem betreuten Vermögen von über 4 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.

LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.

jobs.title: Senior Game Designer - Systems & Economy - Fully Remote
jobs.description:
At SOFTGAMES, we build games played by millions of players worldwide. We are looking for a Senior Game Designer (Systems & Economy) to help evolve our leading games. You will own the long-term evolution of one or two existing games with a loyal player base, balancing player satisfaction, engagement, and commercial performance.

In this role, you will own the design and optimization of progression, economy, events, and monetization systems. Your mission is to continuously evolve these games by creating compelling short-, mid-, and long-term goals that keep players engaged for months and years while maximizing player satisfaction and business performance.

*Qualified applicants will be expected to complete a design test.

This is a remote position.

Your Role:

  • Design, balance, and optimize the game’s economy, progression, and reward systems.

  • Create engaging player motivation loops across events, features, and monetization.

  • Develop and maintain a cohesive ecosystem of LiveOps events, ensuring they work together rather than compete for player attention.

  • Design systems that improve retention, engagement, and monetization while preserving a great player experience.

  • Build and maintain economy models, balancing spreadsheets, and simulations.

  • Use data to identify player friction points, progression bottlenecks, and monetization opportunities.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, BI, UA, Art, and Development teams to improve game performance.

  • Analyze KPIs such as Retention, ARPDAU, Conversion, LTV, and Engagement to guide design decisions.

  • Drive feature and event improvements through continuous testing, iteration, and experimentation.

  • Clearly communicate design rationale, trade-offs, and recommendations across the team.

Your Profile:

  • 5+ years of experience designing and operating successful F2P mobile games.

  • Strong experience in systems design, economy design, progression design, and LiveOps.

  • Proven track record working on casual or puzzle games.

  • Deep understanding of player motivation, retention mechanics, and monetization design.

  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to design and evaluate A/B tests and translate data into actionable improvements.

  • Comfortable making decisions based on KPIs and player behavior.

  • Self-driven and proactive, with the ability to identify opportunities without waiting for direction.

  • Ability to quickly understand new games, systems, and player audiences and take ownership when moving between projects.

  • Advanced spreadsheet skills and experience building balancing, simulation, and forecasting models.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written.

  • Passion for creating engaging and sustainable player experiences.

  • Proficient in using AI tools to improve productivity, analysis, and decision making.

Benefits:

SOFTGAMES offers a competitive package, including:

  • Remote-first, your way — Work fully remote from wherever you do your best work, or drop into our modern Berlin office whenever you like. You choose

  • Flexible hours — Structure your working hours to your needs. No crunch culture. No overtime

  • Generous vacation — Time to recharge, wherever in the world you are

  • Home office budget — We fund your setup so your home office actually works for you

  • Learning & development — Training budget for everyone, whether you're deepening expertise or picking up something entirely new

  • Top-tier equipment — A high-spec laptop, ready to get your best work done

  • Meal allowance — A monthly budget dedicated to your lunches

  • Home office utility grant — We cover a monthly contribution toward your electricity and internet costs

  • Company swag — Hoodies, bags, mugs — the good stuff

  • Annual company retreat — At least once a year, the whole company comes together to connect, align, and celebrate. Our events in general are epic but our off-site Retreat is one of a kind.

At SOFTGAMES, we value a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone's ideas are heard and valued. Join our dynamic team and be part of the exciting world of mobile gaming. Apply now and let your expertise shine!


SOFTGAMES is the leading instant gaming company. We develop casual, truly social games that can be played instantly across all devices. Our hypersocial blockbuster game “Bubble Shooter Pro” became a global top grossing game on Facebook and is played by millions of people around the world every day. We partner closely with Facebook, Samsung and more to craft the next generation of instant games that billions of people can play together. SOFTGAMES is a remote first company and the home of 100 people from all over the world. We believe in proactive, independent teams with the freedom to take initiative, challenge the status quo, and with the mission to create fun and everlasting Instant Games.

At SOFTGAMES, we believe that different perspectives and background in our teams contribute to the quality of our work. We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion / worldview, disability, age as well as sexual orientation and identity.

Have we caught your interest? Then we look forward to your detailed application.

jobs.title: (Senior) Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?

We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe. 

Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. 

It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. 

Ready to awaken your best with us? 

 

About The Role

 

We are looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to drive online revenue growth for Emma's EU Ecommerce team. You will be responsible for owning paid channels campaigns end to end, so that every euro invested delivers a measurable return.

You'll work closely with key stakeholders, ranging from Global Performance Marketing and Creative Marketing to Brand Marketing and the different EU Ecommerce country teams.


What You'll Do
  • Own paid campaigns across Paid Search, Paid Social, Affiliates, Influencer, CRM and TV (linear and CTV), from strategy through execution to continuous optimization.
  • Run A/B tests across creatives, audiences and landing pages, and turn the results into repeatable playbooks that raise performance across your channels and your market.
  • Stay ahead of platform changes, algorithm updates and market trends, and proactively bring new tools, tactics and opportunities to the team.
  • Define and drive performance targets such as ROAS, CPA and conversion rate, and turn data from attribution tools and in-house dashboards into clear strategic decisions.
  • Own your revenue target and deliver local, regional or global projects on time, becoming the go-to expert for the channels you own.
  • Collaborate with global performance and creative teams on ad messaging, budget allocation and channel mix to maximize return on every euro invested.
  • Partner with Sales to drive commercial performance across products and categories in your market, aligning campaign plans with commercial priorities.

Who We're Looking For
  • You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Finance, Business Administration or Engineering, which gives you a solid base for data-driven decisions.
  • You have 3+ years of relevant in-house experience in B2C Ecommerce, ideally in FMCG, consumer goods or online services, with ownership of paid performance channels.
  • You bring strong analytical skills and a strategic understanding of paid channels, turning performance data into decisions that grow revenue and improve ROAS.
  • You have project management experience, having delivered local, regional or global projects on time while aligning multiple stakeholders along the way.
  • You are proactive and self-reflective: you bring ideas instead of waiting for tasks, take feedback well and own your channels with autonomy.
  • You collaborate well and communicate in a structured way, building a strong network across teams, agencies and partners to deliver shared results.
  • You are fluent in English and German.

What We Offer
  • The opportunity to create real impact, take ownership and accountability, and drive meaningful change.
  • Continuous learning and development through hands-on experience, mentoring, formal training, and access to tools such as our Learning Hub and Nilo.
  • A collaborative community of smart, driven people where you learn, contribute, and connect, every day and through team events.
  • A global environment, working daily with diverse perspectives across 4 offices and 70+ nationalities.
  • 25 vacation days per year, with 1 extra day per year worked (until a limit of 30 days per year).
  • A flexible hybrid setup with up to 22 remote days per quarter, and offices in Gutleutviertel - Frankfurt.
Become an Emmie

We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact.

Dein neuer Arbeitsplatz in Verden

Du planst gern selbstständig und willst nicht bei jeder Entscheidung nachfragen müssen? Dann passt diese Stelle zu dir. Das HLS-Planung Ingenieurbüro für Gebäudetechnik von Ralf Spleet in Verden sucht einen Fachplaner TGA in Vollzeit. Du planst Heizung, Lüftung und Sanitär und begleitest deine Projekte bis auf die Baustelle. Bei uns herrschen ein lockerer Umgang und eine positive Atmosphäre. Ein Problem sprichst du offen an und die Geschäftsführung hört dir zu.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Planung von Heizung, Lüftung und Sanitär (HLS/TGA)

  • Erstellung und Überarbeitung von Plänen mit AutoCAD

  • Ausschreibung, Vergabe und Abrechnung mit AVA-Programmen

  • Fachbauleitung auf der Baustelle

  • Schnittstelle zwischen Baustelle und externen Partnern

  • Eigenverantwortliche Abstimmung mit allen Projektbeteiligten

  • Selbstständige Bearbeitung deiner Projekte von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium, Technikerausbildung oder Meisterbrief, idealerweise in TGA, Haus- oder Versorgungstechnik

  • Als Meister oder Techniker: echtes Interesse an der Planung

  • Sicherer Umgang mit AutoCAD und AVA-Programmen

  • Selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Lösungsorientiert: Du sprichst Probleme offen und schnell an, auch gegenüber Leitung und Kollegen

  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung in der Fachbauleitung

Wenn Du dich in diesen Anforderungen wiederfinden und nicht jeden einzelnen Punkt zu 100 Prozent erfüllst, freuen wir uns dennoch auf Deine Bewerbung.

Benefits

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Gleitzeit

  • Freie Strukturierung deines Arbeitsprozesses

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • 40 Stunden pro Woche, keine Dauerüberstunden, bei Mehrarbeit Freizeitausgleich

  • Vergütung nach Berufserfahrung, Zulagen nach Absprache und Unternehmenserfolg

  • Bezahlte Weiterbildung nach Absprache

  • PKW für betriebsbedingte Fahrten

  • Job-Rad oder Ähnliches möglich

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge nach Betriebszugehörigkeit

Vergütung

Für diese Position bieten wir ein attraktives Jahresgehalt von EUR 50.000 – 65.000€

Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Bei uns zählt das Ergebnis und nicht die Zeit am Schreibtisch. Du bekommst Verantwortung, kurze Wege und einen Chef, der zuhört. Klingt das nach dem Job, den du suchst? Dann bewirb dich jetzt. Wir freuen uns auf Dich.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
jobs.description:
Description

Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes.

You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind.


Your mission

1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence 

  • Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution.

  • Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy.

  • Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters.

  • Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo.

2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership 

  • Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer.

  • Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders).

  • Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice.

  • Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos.

3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement 

  • Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation.

  • Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations.

  • Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder.

What We Want to Achieve Together

In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds.

In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount.


Your profile

  • Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies.

  • Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences.

  • Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility.

  • Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data.

  • AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new.

  • A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough.

  • Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both.


Why us?

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer - Autonomy Architecture
jobs.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 


About the Job

The autonomy team at Gravis architects autonomous behaviors for different tasks, e.g. different types of excavation or truck loading. This role owns the architecture that lets those behaviors live in the same software stack as opposed to creating one SW stack per behavior. You'll be responsible for how tasks are decomposed and orchestrated, for the interfaces between, and for the software quality. We are looking for a senior roboticist with C++ and Python expertise and high standards for software quality, who can make clear, pragmatic architectural calls that let the system grow without losing stability.


What you'll do

Architecture

  • Own the task-level architecture shared across our autonomous behaviors

  • Define clear module boundaries and responsibilities between behavior orchestration, factor out common logic across different tasks

  • Implement component tests and telemetry/metrics collection pipelines

  • Identify technical debt early enough to guide the team toward sustainable solutions

  • Act as the go-to person for software quality: modern C++ practices, code structure, error handling, robustness. Likewise for Python.

    • Configuration & tooling

  • Design an easily extensible and testable module for deploying policies that can be reused across tasks and supports schema versioning for observations, so a deployed policy pins the exact version of the computations it was trained against

  • Provide technical leadership on C++ and Python tooling (clang-tidy, sanitizers, static analysis, linting, typing, test setup)

  • Work with our incoming simulation team to unify training, benchmarking and evaluation tooling across tasks, so adding a task doesn't mean forking tooling and infrastructure


    • What we're looking for

    Required

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

  • 5+ years developing complex C++ systems, with deep knowledge of modern C++ (17 and onwards)

  • Strong Python for tooling, configuration and simulation-side scripting

  • Strong experience designing large, modular software systems that outlived their first use case

  • High standards for software quality and long-term maintainability

    • Nice to have

  • Experience with behavior trees, state machines, or other task orchestration frameworks in production

  • Experience working alongside learned controllers in a production stack - deployment, versioning, observation pipelines. No need to train them.

  • Motion planning, geometric algorithms, or spatial data structures

  • Feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms


    • This role is a great fit if…

  • You want to make systems work reliably in the real world, and enjoy thinking through the edge cases

  • You'd rather our next behavior be a configuration than a dedicated piece of software

  • You want the best idea to win regardless of who had it, and you'd rather be corrected by the numbers than agreed with

  • You take a result end-to-end: when something needs to happen, you use or ask for whatever it takes, even outside your scope

  • You're a software purist, but pragmatic — first make it work, then make it right, and cut corners consciously when it's the right call

jobs.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 


About the role

At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators super human capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. All of it runs on Linux, on compute hardware we design ourselves, bolted to the roof of a machine that vibrates, overheats, and regularly loses network coverage.

As a senior engineer focused on the embedded platform, you will own the software layer closest to that hardware: bootloader, kernel, device tree, root filesystem, and the update mechanism that keeps the fleet current. You will work at the intersection of our Hardware, Firmware, Autonomy, and Perception teams to bring up new boards alongside the engineers who designed them, then hand the software organization a platform they can build on without thinking about it. When something fails on site and nobody can yet say whether it's a driver or a solder joint, you are the person who finds out.


What you’ll do

  • Own the embedded Linux platform from end to end: bootloader, kernel, device tree and rootfs.

  • Bring up new hardware alongside electrical engineers.  Take our boards from first power-up to a boot you’d trust on a customer site.

  • Write and maintain the kernel drivers that connect the Rack’s sensors to the autonomy stack

  • Be the low level link between hardware and software teams; the person who can tell a driver bug from a hardware fault.

  • Drive our OTA update and recovery strategy for machines around the world

  • Implement security hardening: secure boot, disk encryption, container isolation, vulnerability patching.

    We recognize that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with varied combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we encourage you to apply.

  • Experience with custom hardware bring-up: pin muxing, clock configuration, regulator control, PCIe, USB, I2C, SPI, UART, CSI, Ethernet.

  • Strong understanding of circuit diagrams and digital electronics.

  • Self-driven, able to take full ownership in a fast-moving startup.

  • Good English (written and spoken) is a must.

Who are we?

The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable.

Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction: detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them.

We sell to navies and coast guards, and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy.

Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa, the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk.

  • Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators.

  • Sign our first contracts.

By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows.

  • Open our priority export markets: the Baltic and the Nordics, the Black Sea, the Gulf and Southeast Asia.

jobs.title: AI Content Manager Intern
jobs.description:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

The internship

You'll shape how Homa communicates, inside and out. You'll operate at the intersection of storytelling, strategy, and AI, turning complex ideas into sharp content that lands with every audience: talent, game studios, partners, investors, and our own teams. There's no shadow work. What you create will be published, presented, and read. You'll develop a 360° understanding of Homa by working with every function, while building your writing, design, and AI skills.

What you'll do

  • Build. Design AI-powered content systems (workflows, prompt libraries, templates) so the team can produce more, faster, without losing quality.
  • Create. Produce high-impact content fast: LinkedIn posts, blog articles, employer branding, internal decks, and strategic presentations.
  • Produce. Use AI tools for images, video, and copy to create high-performing creatives and content for our games.
  • Monitor trends. Track social media trends, competitor content, and new AI tools to stay ahead.
  • Elevate. Spot high-impact opportunities, introduce better formats and tools, and raise the bar for how Homa informs, inspires, and engages.

Why Homa

  • Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest.
  • Real ownership, early. Your projects will change how Homa operates, and you'll see the results.
  • Learn from leadership. You'll work alongside leaders and people who make decisions.
  • A high talent bar. Our teams are small and demanding, and the people around you will push you to grow.
  • AI at the core. You'll have access to the best AI tools, and you'll help shape how an AI-first company works.

Requirements

  • Extreme ownership. You drive outcomes, when something breaks, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.
  • Proactive. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.
  • Pragmatism and simplicity. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship.
  • Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly. You can explain something complex in a few sentences.
  • AI-driven. AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink at least one thing you're proud of.
  • Hungry and motivated. You're ambitious, high-energy, and grounded. You see this internship as a chance to learn faster than anywhere else, and you're ready to work for it.
  • Bonus: you've built something. A game, an app, a student initiative, a side business. We'd love to hear about it.

For this role, you'll also bring:

  • You've created content in some form: a blog, a TikTok page, a newsletter, a portfolio, a standout university project. Show us. We care about what you've made, not where you made it.
  • Sharp writing. You write and speak with clarity and punch, adapt to any audience, and work confidently with anyone.
  • Design instinct. You're fluent in content tools (slides, Canva, Figma, or similar) and build clean, high-quality visuals.

Practical details

  • A 6-month internship, with a flexible start date. We adapt to any month.
  • A convention de stage (internship agreement) is required.
  • Apprenticeships (alternance) are also welcome.
  • Paris based. You'll need to be able to work onsite at our Paris office.
  • Fluent English is required. French is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Top performers may be offered a full-time role at the end of the internship

Our Culture

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

  • Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
  • Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.
  • Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.
  • Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher.

Benefits

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

  • 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
  • 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
  • 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
  • 🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
  • ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
  • 📈 Performance Reviews: We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
  • 💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.

Where We Hire

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

jobs.title: Field Value Engineer (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe.

Europe can reindustrialize if we bring together AI X energy market opportunities X industrial processes. Europe's largest companies (~2% of total energy demand) make their energy decisions with our Energy OS. Behind it is RIZMO: our autonomous AI agent acts as a digital colleague that builds independently, analyzes continuously, iterates with energy management and uncovers cost-saving potential.

As a Field Value Engineer, you bring RIZMO directly to our industrial clients – with both feet on-site. You don't roll out a finished product; you actively build the engine: you train the agent with feedback from the field and make savings visible in euros and megawatt hours. Iteration cycles in hours, not quarters.

Tasks

Digital Twin: Build live models of entire energy systems – power, gas, steam, water, waste heat, generation and battery storage – including smart-meter and OPC UA integration.

Decision Hub: Develop scenarios, business cases, what-if analyses and investment roadmaps together with our clients.

Operation Hub: Support cross-site live optimization across day-ahead, intraday and grid services markets.

Autonomous Agent: Make RIZMO better – parsing technical documents, researching parameters, running optimizations, finding cost reductions – and feed every insight from the field straight back into the engine.

Commercial Ownership: Uncover unstated requirements from operators, plant managers and CFOs, defend business cases up to C-level, and measure your success in euros per unit saved.

Requirements

Education & Background: Degree in energy engineering, automation engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or a comparable STEM qualification.

Energy Intelligence: You understand DACH/EU electricity markets (day-ahead, intraday, grid services), physics and thermodynamics, and how production processes interact with energy. Experience with OPC UA, Modbus and OT networks is a plus.

AI-Native & Applied AI Engineering: You treat hallucinations as an engineering problem, have strong intuition for optimization and numerical models, and can convince even security officers of an agent's reliability.

Maker Mindset (High Agency & High Ownership): You iterate fast, treat customer feedback as your highest-priority input, and deliver results instead of waiting for instructions.

Language Skills: German at C1 level – most on-site work happens in German. If everything else fits but your German isn't C1 yet: apply anyway.

Benefits

Top-Tier Venture Capital Network: Direct access to the Point 9 and Earlybird networks – including formats for sparring, mentoring and further education.

Radical Performance Culture: Exceptional results get rewarded directly – with an uncapped OTE bonus of €5k–50k on top of your base salary. Seniority (junior to senior) is decided during the process, not by your title – don't be put off if you see yourself as more senior. Advancement is based on performance, not tenure.

Unforgettable Team Offsites (Workation): Once a year, the whole team goes on a workation. Including exclusive exchanges with our Visionary Voices (e.g. Robert Habeck, Kitty Mayo, James Vincent).

Corporate Health: Full flexibility for your fitness and health with Urban Sports Club.

On-site Culture & Team Spirit: During your first year, you'll work from our office in Münster – that's where you'll get to know our system in depth and join the first deployments hands-on. After that, you'll work close to our clients in one of our industrial clusters (Rhine-Main, Rhine-Ruhr, Bavaria, Benelux).

Not a customer success job, not 9-to-5, not pure algorithm development. Send us the thing you're proudest of – and what you'd most like to build next.
