jobs.title: People Partner Lead, Corporate Functions, Product & Tech
jobs.description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

About Neko Health

Neko Health is a Swedish healthcare technology company founded in 2018 by Hjalmar Nilsonne and Daniel Ek. Our mission is to redesign healthcare by shifting the focus from reactive treatment to proactive and preventive care.

We are building a new kind of healthcare experience designed to help people stay ahead of their health. By combining medical expertise with breakthrough technology, we make it possible to quickly and non-invasively gather a broad picture of a person's health and deliver clear insights within minutes.

Headquartered in Stockholm and New York, Neko Health offers the Neko Body Scan experience across Europe and the US, supported by a growing team of people working to transform how healthcare is delivered.

Why this role exists

Legal, Finance and People are what let Neko operate, hire and stay compliant as it scales, and Product & Technology is the largest, most complex function at HQ. These aren't the same kind of problem. Each function sits at a different stage of maturity, and this role isn't about pulling them into one shape. It's about moving fluidly between genuinely different disciplines, bringing the right kind of people practice to each, rather than defaulting to a single playbook.

This is one of the most senior People roles at HQ outside the Global People Lead itself. It suits a senior level HR operator who's genuinely comfortable holding several different kinds of problem at once, and who brings real depth in organisational design, workforce planning, strategy and culture, genuine command of each rather than surface-level familiarity.

What you'll do

Own the people agenda across Corporate Functions and partners with the Global People lead on parts of the Product & Tech organisation

  • Lead workforce planning and organisational design across Legal, Finance, People, (and support to parts of the Product & Technology teams) role clarity, resourcing decisions and structural recommendations tailored to each function's stage

  • Meet each function on its own terms, building where a function is still finding its shape, optimising where it's stable, rather than applying one approach everywhere

  • Build genuine partnership with the leaders who run each of these teams, calibrating the relationship to what each one needs

Be the strategic partner to senior leadership

  • Serve as the primary strategic partner across Legal, Finance, People and some of the Product & Technology teams, translating business strategy into people priorities, programmes and operating plans for each function

  • Coach and challenge leaders on the decisions that shape the organisation they'll be running next year, thinking a step ahead of today's priorities

  • Bring sound judgement and discretion to the most sensitive people matters across all four functions

Champion Neko's culture and Vitals

  • Partner with leaders across Legal, Finance, People and parts of the Product & Technology to embed Neko's cultural Vitals into how their teams actually operate, day to day

  • Help leaders translate the Vitals into practical behaviours and decisions across genuinely different functions

  • Build the rituals and feedback loops that keep culture genuinely lived as each function matures at its own pace

Drive talent management across Corporate Functions and Product & Tech

  • Working in partnership with the Growth & Engagement team to drive leadership development, performance and engagement for the leadership population across Legal, Finance, People and Product & Technology

  • Advise on compensation, mobility and promotions in partnership with Reward & Enablement, ensuring internal equity and market competitiveness across genuinely different functions

Lead change and manage risk

  • Lead and sponsor change initiatives that affect structure or operating model in any of these functions, owning scope, timeline, stakeholder engagement and change readiness from start to finish

  • Manage employee relations matters across Legal, Finance, People and Product & Technology, working directly with Legal colleagues and specialist counsel to resolve issues with discretion and confidentiality

  • Spot risk early, whether that's capacity strain in Legal or Finance, or Product & Technology's pace outstripping its structure

Drive organisational design and workforce planning

  • Use workforce and org data to shape decisions ahead of need

  • Deliver people analytics and actionable insights that turn data into clear, decision-ready recommendations

  • Put data and AI to work in how the people agenda runs day to day, sharper decisions, less manual effort

Bring the right practice to functions at different stages

  • Recognise that Legal, Finance, People and Product & Technology each need different structures, rhythms and support, and build accordingly

  • Turn central People programmes into practice that fits each function's actual culture and maturity

  • Experience evaluating how AI informs talent decisions and org design, bringing the judgement to design with AI as a genuine participant in how roles and structures should look, actively shaping the work itself.

What you bring

  • Deep, hands-on experience across organisational design, workforce planning, people strategy and culture, genuine depth in all four, built through direct ownership rather than generalist HRBP exposure

  • 10+ years in senior HR Business Partner, People Partner, or People/HR leadership roles, including ownership of the people agenda across genuinely different functions at Director level or above

  • Experience owning leadership development and performance calibration outcomes for a senior leadership population

  • A track record of personally leading change initiatives end to end: scope, timeline, and stakeholder engagement

  • A genuine passion for culture and values, with experience helping leaders embed them into how their teams actually work

  • A track record of partnering with and influencing senior functional leaders on complex, high-stakes organisational decisions, operating with genuine autonomy as an independent decision-maker

  • Comfort holding functions at very different stages of maturity at once, adapting approach rather than applying one framework to all

  • Fluent with people data and actively using AI in your own work

  • Working knowledge of employment law relevant to Neko's HQ locations, with the judgement to know when to bring in specialist expertise

About Titles at Neko

We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so internal titles may differ from market-facing role titles. Scope, impact and level of the role are fully aligned and will be clearly discussed throughout the process.

Hiring Process

Candidates progress from application and structured screening through thoughtfully designed interviews, culminating in a formal offer and final pre-employment checks before joining the team.

Neko Health is committed to inclusive hiring and member-first care. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to request reasonable adjustments to support your application.

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

We’re looking for an experienced Ultrasound sonographer to join our multidisciplinary team in London on a 12 month fixed term contract and help to take ultrasounds as part of a clinical research study.

This is a key role focused on delivering high-quality, independent assessments. You’ll perform and interpret ultrasound scans of adult women who are receiving a breast ultrasound as part of a clinical study. You will work in conjunction with the principal investigator of the study to ensure that assessments and reports are of research-grade quality. This is a fixed term role that lasts for the duration of the study and is based at our clinics in London.

What You’ll Deliver

  • Perform high-quality diagnostic ultrasound examinations in line with clinical guidelines and best practices with focus on breast ultrasound

  • Pass on the study-specific acquisition and interpretation qualification task before performing study scans, with certificate filed in the investigational site file.

  • Independently interpret and report ultrasound findings, ensuring timely delivery of results that are uploaded to a standardised electronic case report form.

  • Collaborate with our multidisciplinary research team to help deliver Neko’s clinical trial focused on better understanding risks of breast cancer.

  • Adherence to the study acquisition SOP

  • Equipment QA maintenance logged on-site. Liaise directly with the study PI and research team where needed.

Minimum Requirements

  • HCPC-registered diagnostic radiographer (or other HCPC-/NMC-registered healthcare professional), holding a CASE-accredited postgraduate qualification in breast ultrasound (PgCert / PgDip / MSc, or a named CASE-accredited breast ultrasound module.

  • Documented, current breast ultrasound practice, with a minimum of two years’ full-time-equivalent breast scanning.

  • Advanced radiographic experience of reporting autonomously within the NHS Breast Screening Programme (NHSBSP) or an equivalent quality-assurance framework.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly to study participants.

  • Commitment to maintaining high clinical standards and engaging in ongoing professional development.

Preferred

  • Experience with previous ultrasound scanning as part of clinical trials

  • Experience with shear-wave elastography acquisition and reporting.

  • Experience with Philips US machines, and decision support software

  • Familiarity with data entry as part of clinical research studies.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The Opportunity

We are at an inflection point in our journey. Our platform now serves tens of thousands of learners, demand for AI skills is accelerating, and we are investing seriously in the product and technology that will take us to the next stage of scale. This is a role for someone who wants to build the product that gets more people into transformative learning, and upskill people with critical data and AI skills faster.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own Prescribe: the product that helps a prospective learner find the right programme for their skills and their employer's goals, then takes them to a confident commitment and a successful start. You will be the strategic counterpart to a Senior Engineering Manager, working alongside design and data, and closely with our go-to-market and fulfilment teams.

Growth at Multiverse means getting more people from first interest to a confident start, and it is a product problem, not a marketing problem. You will own the conversion metrics, set the strategy, run the experiments, and drive the outcomes. AI will drive much of the improvement, and you will decide where it helps.

As a Lead, you will work regularly with the most senior leaders across the company. You will report to the Single Threaded Leader for Diagnose & Prescribe and will not manage other product managers. The role is based in London, hybrid, three days a week in the office.

What You'll Own

AI-native product experiences

  • Shape new conversational, AI-first experiences that help learners and customers understand the best programme for their skills and career development.

  • Decide where AI genuinely improves a match and where it only adds noise, and build the evaluation and guardrails that keep it trustworthy in front of real users.

  • Turn learner and customer behaviour into product direction.

Prescription and eligibility

  • Own the logic that connects a learner's skills to a programme and to a customer's levy funding, where mistakes carry a real financial and regulatory cost.

  • Work with Legal, Compliance and Fulfilment to make eligibility and compliance rules configurable and explainable, so business owners can change them without a rebuild.

  • Make every recommendation something a learner and a customer can understand and challenge.

Recommendation, commitment and finalisation

  • Own the journey from recommendation to a learner committing and starting.

  • Identify high-leverage drop-off points and own the experimentation roadmap.

  • Design product interventions that adapt to learner needs and behaviour and shorten the time to a confident start.

  • Collaborate with GTM, Operations and Data teams to improve attribution and the quality of what enters the funnel.

Metrics and experimentation

  • Own conversion from prospect to committed learner, with retention and programme fit as the guardrails.

  • Champion a culture of hypothesis-led, structured experimentation.

Cross-functional Leadership

  • Co-own the strategy and roadmap with your Senior Engineering Manager, with disagreement surfaced early and alignment as your shared deliverable.

  • Involve GTM, Fulfilment and Support before changes ship. They run what we build, so know their biggest pain points.

  • Author the narratives the group needs, from the press release and FAQ (PRFAQ) for your area to the sales-facing briefing for a launch.

  • Represent Prescribe in roadmap conversations with senior leadership.

What We're Looking For

The best candidates will have owned a growth-critical product before, ideally in a B2B or ideally a B2B2C context. You should have hands-on experience shipping AI-powered features and the ability to navigate complexity without losing sight of the learner.

Must-have experience:

  • Substantial experience as a PM with a track record of improving measurable growth metrics (acquisition, activation, retention, automation).

  • Confidence with data: pulling analysis, running cohort studies, and building dashboards.

  • Experience designing and running rigorous A/B and multivariate experiments.

  • Strong instincts for user experience and a focus on sustainable long-term strategies.

  • Ability to build alignment across cross-functional teams without formal authority, including with commercial, GTM and operations counterparts.

  • Hands-on experience building products using AI/LLMs to generate or personalise content.

  • AI Builder mindset with experience of using AI as your engine to drive repeatable and automated systems, processes and artefacts that create step changes in performance and efficiencies.

Strong signals we look for:

  • Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) in a B2B context.

  • Experience designing personalisation systems, including data models and trigger logic.

  • Previous work in a company that has scaled from hundreds to thousands of users.

  • A point of view on where AI genuinely improves outcomes versus creating noise.

  • A bonus if you've done this in a regulated environment, such as funding, eligibility or compliance-heavy products. Knowledge of UK apprenticeships and the levy is an additional plus.

How you work:

  • Solve for Customer Value: You're direct about data, even when it challenges existing priorities.

  • Drivers, Not Passengers: You think in systems, take completion seriously, and raise bad news as quickly as good.

  • Be Decisive, Even in Ambiguity: You're comfortable with ambiguity and define structure in new spaces.

  • AI to Deliver Outcomes: You have a bias for action (ship, measure, iterate) and ask "how would AI help do this?" before scoping the work.

Not for you if:

This role won't fit if you'd rather write specs than stay close to the data, the design, and the customer. It also won't fit if you see AI as a productivity tweak rather than a step change in how a product team works. And it needs someone who renegotiates scope out loud when it's wrong, not someone who absorbs it and hopes it works out.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on a product that genuinely changes economic trajectories.

  • A team that takes craft seriously and holds a high bar.

  • Direct access to senior leadership and meaningful influence over product direction.

  • A place in a company rebuilding itself as product-powered and AI-native, where you help define the result rather than inherit it.

Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

  • Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

  • Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy, our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).

For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings.

To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

Over 200,000 businesses run on DeepL, and their stories are the most persuasive asset we have. This role puts them front and centre across brand, demand and growth. Buyers evaluating Language AI trust other buyers. We're building the proof that puts customer stories in front of them at scale.

You'll sit in Product Marketing, report to the VP, and work at pace with Field, Brand, Digital, Comms and PR.

 

Your responsibilities

  • Amplify our customers’ success: Surface the stories our customers are already telling within support tickets, sales nominations, deal wins and win-loss interviews, and choose the few that deserve to become full stories. Ship marquee stories (blue-chip, video, event-ready), named case studies and quantified proof points that show DeepL's AI doing real work in real businesses.

  • Put our customers on the world stage: Press interviews, webinars, keynotes and our Customer Advisory Board advocacy track. You recommend who speaks, agree the narrative with them in advance, and make each appearance count beyond the day itself..

You'll know which customers will speak, what they'll speak about, and how recently each was asked. Sales enablement builds the seller tools - you supply the customers and the proof that goes inside them.

  • Share stories while they still matter: Stories work hardest published alongside a launch, event or campaign they belong to. You own the run from interview to live asset, including the legal and brand engagement, and keep customer permissions current so nothing sits waiting.

 

Measures of success (first 12 months)

  • New marquee stories the field, brand and events teams all pull from.

  • Named case studies covering every region, product lines and priority verticals

  • Reference requests resolved within the agreed turnaround time

  • Stories publishing in the same window as the launch or event they belong to

  • Clear evidence that deals using a customer reference close at a better rate

 

Qualities we look for

  • Proven success in B2B marketing, over many years: customer marketing, content, comms or advocacy, with a track record of stories that engaged buyers and moved deals

  • Bias for action: you're a self-starter who clears your own hurdles. You do not wait for a brief

  • Automate before you escalate: when a step is slow, your instinct is to build a way round it. AI is already in your workflow, not on your list of things to try.

  • Storytelling: genuine curiosity about a customer's business problem, and the instinct to find the narrative inside it

  • Customer-facing polish: comfortable with customers from first discovery call through to launch

  • Strategic judgement: you can map advocacy output to our priorities and back the stories that serve them

  • Operational rigour: you have built the production, approvals and permissions process - and made it fast

 

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

jobs.title: Algorithm Developer (m/w/x)
jobs.description:
Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe.

Europe's plants run on gas, power, heat and steam – and all of them are being rebuilt at the same time. The hard part isn't ambition, it's arithmetic: which asset to buy, when to run it, what to hedge. Europe's largest companies (~2% of total energy demand) answer these questions with our Energy OS: a digital twin of the site, an optimizer that plans it, and agents that operate it.

The optimizer is yours. Twenty-year investment decisions, quarter-hourly dispatch, real tariffs, real market rules. You report directly to the CTO – and nobody stands between your model and the plant it runs on.

Tasks

Optimization Models End-to-End: Own capacity expansion planning over multi-year horizons, dispatch at quarter-hour resolution, and MIP production scheduling with sequence-dependent setup times.

Model Physics & Contracts: Storage, thermal networks, transmission, flexibility, self-consumption, minimum part loads, start-up costs – formulate what reality actually demands.

Make It Solve: Tighten big-Ms, scale models cleanly, decide where decomposition earns its complexity – and where it doesn't.

Smart Data Reduction: Time series clustering, extreme periods, segmentation and aggregation – without accuracy quietly disappearing.

Regulation into Constraints: Model grid fees, levies, tariffs, balancing power and intraday trading per country, and understand what they do to the objective function.

Prove It's Right: Test cases on real customer systems, fixtures that catch regressions, and infeasibility output an engineer can actually diagnose.

Interface & Production: Define inputs and outputs with the Product Engineers; own the runs on Kubernetes – solve time, memory and cost are your numbers.

Explain to the Customer: When a customer questions a schedule, you're the one who can say why the model chose it.

Requirements

Education & Background: Degree in mathematics, operations research, computer science, physics, energy systems engineering, business mathematics or a comparable STEM qualification.

Optimization: Deep familiarity with LP and MILP and the craft around it – formulation strength, relaxations, warm starts, solver behavior.

Practice over Papers: You've taken a model from formulation to production that others depended on.

Code & Solvers: Strong Julia – or strong Python/C++ and a real appetite to learn Julia (JuMP) fast. Hands-on with Gurobi or HiGHS, including reading logs and knowing when to reformulate instead of tuning.

Data Sense & Engineering: Comfortable with long time series, unit and sign conventions; tests, version control, code review and CI are second nature.

AI-Native: Claude Code, agents and subagents are part of your daily loop – a requirement, not a plus.

High Ownership, Low Ceremony: You take on the unclear. Energy domain knowledge helps but isn't required.

Nice to have: Stochastic or robust optimization, Benders or column generation, unit commitment, energy market modeling.

Benefits

Share in the Success: Competitive base salary plus equity – we set your level during the process, not based on your CV.

Top-Tier Venture Capital Network: Direct access to the Point 9 and Earlybird networks – including formats for sparring, mentoring and further education.

Unforgettable Team Offsites (Workation): Once a year, the whole team goes on a workation. Including exclusive exchanges with our Visionary Voices (e.g. Robert Habeck, Kitty Mayo, James Vincent).

Corporate Health: Full flexibility for your fitness and health with Urban Sports Club.

Out to the Plant: Seeing the boiler you modeled changes how you build the product.

Our stack: Julia with JuMP on Gurobi and HiGHS, forecasting in Python, the product in TypeScript (Vue, Node, PostgreSQL), Google Cloud with Kubernetes for optimization jobs, GitLab CI, agents on LangGraph.

Small team, no layers between you and the decision. A model change that lands on Tuesday is in front of the customer on Thursday. In-person onboarding, then hybrid from Munich, Düsseldorf or Münster.

Not a research position without deployment – and not a place where solve time is someone else's problem.

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner - Internal Operating System & AI (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Tangany, based in Munich, is a highly innovative technology company with a market-leading B2B solution for the custody of digital assets on the blockchain (e.g. cryptocurrencies & tokenized assets). Our solution is already used by more than 40 institutional customers. Tangany is regulated by the German federal financial supervisory authority, BaFin.

Using our modern API, we enable our customers to easily and securely integrate blockchain functionalities into their systems. This white-label solution reduces development costs and time, enabling fast market access and ease of use for end users. Regulatory requirements can be covered for appropriate assets via Tangany's crypto custody license if required. For our continued growth, we are looking for a Senior Product Owner - Internal Operating System & AI (f/m/d) to join our team.

Your role

Our engineering works in three product teams. Two of them build for our partners: one the portals, the other the API and our custody core. The third works inward, and you will own its product. Its mandate is to run Tangany's operations as efficiently as possible. Business and product operations processes such as transaction operations, billing, forecasting and KPI reporting get digitised, automated, or handed to AI agents where that is the better solution. Much of this runs today on a self-hosted Retool platform. Whether we keep extending it or replace it with an AI-native solution on top of the APIs our other teams provide is one of the first calls you will shape.

The team works process-first. You map each process end-to-end with the people who run it, redesign it, and only then decide how it gets automated. The team's tech lead owns the engineering, and you own what gets built, in which order and why. Beyond your team, you are responsible for AI at Tangany: governance, enablement and tooling for the whole company.

Who we are looking for

You are a senior Product Owner who has shipped AI in a business setting yourself, whether LLM-based tools, agentic workflows or AI-assisted development, and you can explain what worked and what did not. You run discovery before anyone asks for it: you bring problems onto the roadmap that nobody requested, write your assumptions down before the build so they can be checked afterwards, and your specs catch the interaction that would break a neighbouring system before engineering finds it. When departments pull in different directions, you hold the priority and say no with a reason the requester accepts. You want to be measured by outcomes such as fewer manual steps, fewer iterations and lower cost per process.

Tasks

  • Own vision, roadmap and backlog of Tangany's Internal Operating System, the internal tooling every department works with, starting with the Retool-based operations portal.
  • Map business and product operations processes end to end with Compliance, Operations, Finance and the other departments that run them and redesign them before anything gets automated.
  • Decide per process whether it becomes an application built with AI-assisted development, an agentic flow, or a tool we buy. Back each decision with cost and benefit, then measure what the process costs before and after and report the result.
  • Write specifications that engineering can build from without a rework round, including edge cases, what is out of scope, and the regulatory requirement behind each rule. Agree on the interfaces your processes need with the portal and API teams.
  • Shape Tangany's AI strategy and own AI governance: usage policies, rules for which data may be processed by which AI system, and the approval of AI tools and vendors, in line with our obligations as a BaFin-regulated institution.
  • Drive AI enablement and own the AI tooling for all employees. You train teams, run our internal AI programme, select and roll out the tools, and turn individual experiments that work into shared standards.

Requirements

  • Several years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, including time in a senior role, ideally on internal platforms, operations tooling or process automation.
  • Experience mapping and redesigning end-to-end processes with business stakeholders (BPMN or a comparable method) and automating them afterwards.
  • Experience in a regulated environment, ideally financial services or crypto custody. You can tell a real obligation from a habit and design processes so that requirements under GwG, KWG, MiCA or DORA are met by construction. Knowledge of the EU AI Act is a plus.
  • Solid technical understanding: you read API documentation and data models and talk to engineers as a peer. Writing code is not part of the role.
  • Enthusiasm for blockchain technologies; blockchain knowledge is a plus.
  • Fluent in German and English (C1 or higher).

Benefits

Flexibility & Work-Life-Balance:

  • 30 days of vacation plus ½ day off December 24th and December 31st and additional unpaid leave if needed to recharge your battery.
  • Two weeks of extra paid vacation for new parents.
  • The flexibility to work from home or in our beautiful office in the heart of Munich.
  • Possibility to go on workation for up to 40 days per year.
  • Flexible working hours, you work when you are most productive.

Your development:

  • It starts from day one: With our onboarding that is tailored to your needs, you will receive a structured onboarding plan and feedback talks within the probation period (and of course after).
  • We grow and we want you to grow with us. Learning on the job, becoming a blockchain expert, exchanging knowledge with our highly motivated, well-rehearsed team with diverse skill sets, as well as taking part in individual training - our learning culture enables you to bring you personal and professional development to the next level.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We're looking for a CTO who wants to own engineering end to end: the systems, the people, and the standards for a company whose work changes lives.

  • Keep us moving fast as we get bigger: We deliberately favour fewer processes, simple designs, and deeply understood tools, because that's what lets a small team operate a system this important. Your job is to protect that as the headcount grows and ensure more ownership per engineer, and a clear view of where complexity is worth the tradeoff.
  • Own reliability: Wave is the financial system for tens of millions of people. You'll set the standards for uptime, incident response, and how carefully we change things that move money and you'll be accountable when we fall short.
  • Build and lead the leadership layer: You'll inherit 5 direct reports and an engineering organization of ~100 people including security, data and infrastructure. You will be responsible for hiring, developing, and where necessary replacing engineering managers and directors. You'll be personally involved in senior hiring.
  • Set our vision on AI: Set our vision on AI. We're already seeing AI accelerate product velocity, but we think we're in the early days of what we can do with AI in our apps and to move faster across the org. We want you to make Wave a truly AI forward organization.
  • Support expansion. Wave already has over 25M users with accelerating growth. This scale and each new market brings new challenges and constraints. You'll help us plan the right architecture and organisational structure to help us grow smoothly and consistently.
  • Represent engineering to the company. Wave is very transparent, whether that's defaulting to public conversations in slack, frequent Ask Wave Anything sessions, or defaulting to writing public docs to explain major decisions. You'll communicate openly and clearly about what engineering is doing and why, to an audience that includes engineers, non-engineers, our leadership team, and our when needed regulators.

Key details

Reports to: Drew Durbin, CEO.

Team: Around ~100 engineers across 5 teams (Payment, User-facing products, Internal, non-product teams and platform) plus 5 leaders. Engineering teams are co-led by Product Managers and an engineering manager. 

Stack: Python 3 with mypy on the backend, GraphQL API layer, Postgres and Redis, Kotlin/Jetpack on Android (our main client), Swift/SwiftUI on iOS, TypeScript and React on the web. Infrastructure on GCP, managed with Kubernetes and Terraform. Most backend work happens in a large Python monolith, deployed across multi-country architecture. Current in-flight work includes agentic developer tooling, a large scale migration of our databases, and some refactoring of our monolith.

Location: Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (Spain, UK, East Coast of USA, Canada, Kenya, Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, etc. Expect to travel to our markets a minimum of twice per year to stay close to local realities, products, teams and of course our users. Wave covers all costs.

Compensation: Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary of up to $356,500 USD, plus a generous equity package:

  • Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support coworking meetups with teammates.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
    • 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.
    • Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days exclusive of statutory holidays.
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Process: The process runs up to 5 conversations, including 2 technical discussions. We want this to be a 2-way assessment: as much a chance for you to evaluate us as for us to get to know you. Along the way you'll meet our CEO, Head of People, Head of Product, both Engineering Directors, and a senior leader from one of our markets.

Requirements

  • You've managed an engineering organisation of at ~100 people, including managers who manage others. You can describe how your own job changed as the org grew.
  • You have a software engineering background and are good at it. You can still read code and follow a technical argument to the end.
  • You've been accountable for a system where failure was expensive: money, safety, or regulated data.
  • You've hired senior engineering leaders, and you've moved someone out of a role that wasn't working. You can talk about both honestly.
  • You write well. Clear, short, and persuasive, for readers who aren't engineers.
  • You have a clear and positive point of view on AI in engineering: something you've tried, changed, or abandoned, not a plan to look into it.
  • You believe in what we're building and can say why without being prompted.

You might be a good fit if you

  • Would rather run a great team than be the smartest engineer in the room, and don't feel a loss in that trade.
  • Are comfortable being the person who says the unwelcome thing in a meeting, and can do it without making it personal.
  • Change your mind in public when the evidence changes.
  • Prefer the simplest system that works to the most interesting one.
  • Care about what our users actually experience: how long a transfer takes on a bad network, what happens to a shop owner when a deposit fails and bring that up unprompted when discussing infrastructure.
  • Take responsibility for outcomes rather than processes, including when the outcome is bad.
  • Are drawn to a company that publishes its numbers internally every month, expects direct feedback in both directions, and would rather be embarrassingly honest than comfortable.

Our team

The role

Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories.

You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market.

Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications.

This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams.

Your mission

Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable.

You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it.

The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate.

What you will do

Drive technical co-builds with partners

  • Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept.

  • Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks.

  • Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure.

  • Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories.

  • Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets.

  • Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility.

Produce technical marketing content

  • Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives.

  • Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations.

  • Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets.

  • Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember.

  • Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity.

Build for the audience

  • Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work.

  • Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype.

  • Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance.

  • Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology.

  • Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication.

What we are looking for

  • A strong engineering background

  • The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems.

  • Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video.

  • A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation.

  • Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value.

  • Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams.

  • The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

This role may suit you if

  • You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing.

  • You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value.

  • You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market.

  • You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems.

  • You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message.

This role is probably not for you if

  • Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations.

  • You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it.

  • You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete.

  • You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes.

How the role complements Product Marketing

Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity.

The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content.

What success looks like

Within the first year, you will have:

  • Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners.

  • Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities.

  • Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos.

  • Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance.

  • Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

Sie möchten moderne Cloud-Plattformen gestalten und die technische Basis für skalierbare Anwendungen schaffen? Als Senior Platform Engineer (m/w/d) AWS verantworten Sie die Weiterentwicklung einer zentralen AWS-Plattform, automatisieren Infrastrukturprozesse und entwickeln sichere sowie standardisierte Lösungen für moderne SaaS-Anwendungen. Dabei verbinden Sie technisches Know-how mit Architekturverständnis und einem hohen Maß an Eigenverantwortung.

Sie kennen jemanden, der auf die Stellenausschreibung passt? Dann holen Sie jetzt unseren Weiterempfehlungsbonus! Erkundigen Sie sich gleich telefonisch unter 089 9982966 47 bei mir.

Aufgaben

  • Konzeption standardisierter Cloud-Lösungen und Golden Paths für AWS und Amazon EKS
  • Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb einer zentralen AWS-Multi-Account-Plattform als technische Basis für die Produktteams
  • Beratung und Unterstützung der Entwicklungsteams bei Architektur-, Security-, Observability- und BetriebsfragenAutomatisierung von Infrastruktur und Deployment-Prozessen mit Terraform, GitHub und modernen DevOps-Methoden
  • Entwicklung technischer Standards für Security, Networking, Governance, Skalierbarkeit und Cloud-Betrieb

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im IT-Umfeld oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie praktische Erfahrung im Cloud-Umfeld
  • Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, idealerweise Terraform oder AWS CDK, sowie modernen CI/CD-Prozessen
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in AWS, insbesondere in den Bereichen Networking, Security und Multi-Account-Architekturen
  • Kenntnisse in Observability-Lösungen wie Datadog, OpenTelemetry oder vergleichbaren Technologien; Erfahrung mit Kubernetes/EKS von Vorteil
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, eigenständige Arbeitsweise und Freude an technischer Beratung und teamübergreifender Zusammenarbeit

Benefits

  • 100 % Remote und deutschlandweites Arbeitsmodell
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungsangebote, unter anderem über LinkedIn Learning, sowie attraktive Mitarbeitervorteile
  • Flexible Zuschüsse von bis zu 60 € monatlich für Hansefit, EGYM Wellpass, Kinderbetreuung oder JobRad
  • Aktienkaufprogramm, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Angebote zur mentalen Gesundheit über TELUS Health
  • 30 Tage Urlaub sowie eine Werbeprämie von 1000 Euro bei erfolgreicher Empfehlung

jobs.title: Senior Product Performance Analyst (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About Trusted Shops

Trusted Shops creates digital trust between people, businesses, and AI Agents. Every day, millions of consumers rely on our solutions to make confident online decisions, while businesses use our products to build trust, strengthen customer relationships, and grow sustainably.

With around 700 colleagues across Europe, more than 25,000 online shops, and over 40 million consumers in our Community of Trust, we are helping shape a safer and more transparent digital world. But trust is not only at the heart of our products, it also shapes how we work together. We believe in collaboration, ownership, and the freedom to do your best work through a flexible hybrid work culture. Join us and help create a digital world where trust, transparency, and meaningful connections drive every interaction.

To strengthen our Product Department, we are looking for a

Senior Product Performance Analyst (m/f/d)

(Hybrid in Cologne or Berlin / Full-time / Permanent contract)

As a Senior Product Performance Analyst, you'll turn scattered data into clear direction: unified KPIs, consistent dashboards, and actionable insights that influence product strategy and prioritization. Working closely with Product Managers and Product leadership, you'll help create a scalable data foundation that enables measurable decision-making across our Product organization. Your work will ensure that product investments, outcomes, and customer impact are guided by reliable data and transparent performance measurements.

Your Responsibilities

  • Identify business requirements for data streams based on business processes and customer journeys and manage them independently.

  • Turn data into clear stories: build high-quality standard reports, dashboards, and visualizations for a wide range of stakeholder groups.

  • Standardize reporting, KPI definitions, and tracking approaches across Product teams to improve consistency and data quality.

  • Manage projects related to data provisioning from the data lake and ensure reliable access to relevant product data.

  • Partner with Product Managers and Product leadership to develop new KPIs and evaluate product impact.

  • Act as a trusted advisor on measurement, tracking concepts, and performance evaluation within the Product organization.

  • Support the product teams in the early stages of product development in formulating the right hypotheses and success metrics to shape the development phase and create the needed data points.


Your Profile

  • Degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, or equivalent practical experience.

  • At least 5 years of experience in Product Analytics, partnering closely with Product Managers and Product Development teams.

  • Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience working with data lakes or data warehouses.

  • Proficiency with BI, reporting, and data visualization tools.

  • Proven experience building KPI frameworks, reporting standards, and scalable measurement structures.

  • Independent, project-oriented working style with the ability to communicate complex data insights to diverse stakeholders.

  • Analytical thinking and statistical skills.

  • Business fluent English; additional language skills are a plus.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid Work: Combine flexible remote work with shared team days in the office

  • Workation: Temporarily work from a destination of your choice within the EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein or Norway

  • 28 vacation days, 2.5 additional days off at Christmas, New Year's Eve and Carnival

  • Buddy programme with support from an experienced Trustee

  • Individual development opportunities and learning offerings

  • Team, unit and company events

  • Health Pass with free online and offline sports, fitness and health courses

BUILD A COMMUNITY OF TRUST WITH US - #cometotrust

At Trusted Shops, we are interested in you as a person. Whether you fit in with us is independent of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity. Trusted Shops is clearly committed to diversity and against discrimination

jobs.title: Founding Brand Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über Aampere

Werde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert. Seit unserem Launch ermöglichen wir EV-Besitzern einen schnellen & reibungslosen Verkauf innerhalb von 48h. Kaufende Händler aus ganz Europa haben Zugriff auf E-Autos von bisher nicht erschlossene Kundengruppen.

Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Sixt, Porsche, Mercedes, Enterprise und Cazoo.


Deine Mission

Wir bauen bei Aampere gerade eine Marke von 0 auf. Bisher kommen über 95 % unserer Kunden aus Growth Marketing und unsere Brand Awareness bei EV-Fahrern liegt bei ca. 5 bis 10 %.
Da wir eine starke B2C-Brand aufbauen wollen, wissen wir, dass wir früh in Brand investieren müssen. Wer in Deutschland ein E-Auto verkaufen will, soll automatisch an Aampere denken und wir suchen die Person, die das für uns umsetzt.
Die Strategie legst du mit dem Head of Marketing fest. Die Umsetzung liegt komplett bei dir, ohne Micro-Management im Tagesgeschäft.

Du planst die Kampagnen und führst sie auch durch. Du entscheidest Umfang, Region, Kanäle und Botschaft, von OOH über YouTube bis PR und Community. Nichts ist vorentschieden. Du testest Regionen gegeneinander und skalierst, was gewinnt.
Du bestimmst, wofür Aampere steht. Aus Research zu Kunden, Markt und Wettbewerb entstehen Positionierung, Narrative und Tone of Voice. Das Fundament gibt es noch nicht, aber die Research dafür würde schon gestartet.
Du denkst über Awareness Kanäle hinaus. Ein großer Teil unserer Brand Wahrnehmung entsteht während des Sales Prozesses. Du denkst vom ersten bis zum letzten Touchpoint der Customer Journey und sorgst in den richtigen Momenten für die richtige Message & Erfahrung.
Du bekommst ein sechsstelliges Budget. Wir planen ein festes Budget für Brand in 2027 ein. Wohin wir es investieren, liegt komplett bei dir.


Das bringst du mit

Du hast eine Brand von null mitgebaut. 4 bis 6 Jahre Brand-Erfahrung im B2C, Startup oder startup-nah. Du hast nicht ein bereits bestehendes System verwaltet, sondern eines aufgebaut.
Du denkst von Konzept bis Go-Live. Du hast Multi-Channel-Kampagnen bereits selbst konzipiert und live gebracht. Du weißt genau, wann welcher Kanal der richtige ist und wie wir unsere Message gezielt an die Kunden übermitteln. Du musst dabei nicht jeden Schritt selbst ausführen, sondern kannst auch auf externe Ressourcen zurückgreifen.
Du hast kreative Ideen und verstehst, weshalb sie funktionieren. Wir suchen die Person, die auf Sachen kommt, an die im Growth-Team niemand denkt. Zeig uns eine Kampagne, die es ohne dich nicht gegeben hätte und was danach messbar anders war.
Du baust das Fundament, nicht nur die Maßnahmen. Gute Kampagnen entstehen nur durch eine gute Grundlage. Du weißt, wie man aus Research eine Brand-Identity baut und kannst sie genau erklären.
Du bist ein Operator. Du führst eigenständig Audits, Feldbefragungen und Kampagnen durch. Du wartest nicht auf Ansagen und brauchst niemanden, der dich steuert.
Du denkst in Ergebnissen. Uns ist bewusst, dass Brand nicht 100% messbar ist. Trotzdem erwarten wir Outcome-getriebenes Handeln. Du findest heraus, wie wir eine starke, wiedererkennbare Marke bauen und erst Deutschland und anschließend EU-weit distribuieren.
Du bist AI-native. Eigene, kreative Ideen sind uns extrem wichtig. Für die Umsetzung solltest du allerdings AI allerdings als Hebel nutzen können, um Ideen schneller auf die Straße zu bringen.
Deutsch ist deine Muttersprache. Unser B2C-Messaging findet zunächst in Deutschland statt. Gutes Englisch setzen wir voraus.


Why Aampere?

Startup Umfeld: jeden Tag etwas bewirken und gemeinsam mit uns die Welt elektrisieren
Persönliches Wachstum: Im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du schnell aufsteigen und Verantwortung übernehmen
Tech: Ob Apple oder Windows, dein Laptop wird von uns gestellt. Du entscheidest, womit du am besten arbeitest.
Urban Sports Club und 58€ Ticket: healthy team, happy team
Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats)
Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what’s next?
Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im naheliegenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten - mit Blick auf das Riesenrad. 


Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn...

...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind. Deshalb bist du mindestens vier Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office.

...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten.

...du einen fertigen Plan brauchst, bevor du loslegst. Seed Stage heißt: vieles ist unklar und ändert sich wöchentlich. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, im Ungewissen zu entscheiden und unterwegs zu korrigieren.

...du in deiner Lane bleiben willst. "Das ist nicht mein Job" kennen wir nicht. Du packst da an, wo es brennt, auch wenn es außerhalb deiner Rollenbeschreibung liegt.

...du einen klassischen 9-to-5-Job willst. Wir bauen etwas Großes und das geht nicht nebenbei. Wer hier ist, will Vollgas geben, statt nur die Zeit abzusitzen.


Wie wir arbeiten

Drei Werte, keine Poster an der Wand, sondern wie wir täglich arbeiten, einstellen und wachsen:

Aaudacity. Wir sind mutig genug, Risiken einzugehen, und schnell genug, es nicht halbherzig zu tun.
Aambition to grow. Wir wollen wachsen, als Menschen und als Unternehmen.
Aampact over Hierarchy. Die beste Idee gewinnt, egal von wem sie kommt. Titel entscheiden hier keine Diskussion.


Noch ein paar Worte zum Abschluss

Bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns über Deine formlose Bewerbung - alles weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam.

Egal, welchen Hintergrund, welche Herkunft oder welche Geschlechtsidentität du mitbringst – bei uns zählt, wer du als Person bist. Wir fördern eine Kultur des Respekts und Miteinanders, in der jede Stimme gehört wird, persönliche Weiterentwicklung möglich ist und Wertschätzung an erster Stelle steht.

Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene und der Automobilwelt, mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Alasco, Porsche, Mercedes und KPMG.

Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen. Wenn du etwas bewegen möchtest, dann werde Teil unseres Teams.


Deine Mission

Du hast Lust auf direkten Kundenkontakt, gehst gerne auf Menschen zu und Autos sind für dich nicht einfach nur Fortbewegungsmittel, sondern ein echtes Interesse? Dann bist du bei uns im Sales Team genau richtig. 

Operativer Vertrieb: Du unterstützt unser Sales Team dabei, Fahrzeuge für die Auktion vorzubereiten: von der Prüfung der Daten bis hin zur finalen Aufbereitung für die Plattform.
Prozessbegleitung: Du begleitest unsere Verkäufer:innen durch den gesamten Verkaufsprozess. Vom ersten telefonischen Kontakt bis zur Planung der Übergabe sorgst du dafür, dass intern alles reibungslos läuft.
Sales-Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe, bringst Ideen ein und hilfst mit, unsere Prozesse schlanker, effizienter und skalierbarer zu gestalten.
Feedback für Produkt und Team: Du gibst Erkenntnisse aus dem Kundenkontakt weiter und hilfst so, unser Produkt gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.
Startup-Alltag: Du bringst dich dort ein, wo du gebraucht wirst, mit deinen individuellen Stärken und Interessen.


Das bringst du mit

Dein Background: Du bist aktuell immatrikuliert im Bachelor- oder Masterstudium. Dein Studiengang ist für uns zweitrangig, viel wichtiger sind deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und dein Blick für saubere Prozesse.
Kommunikationsstärke: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, telefonierst gerne und fühlst dich im direkten Kundenkontakt wohl.
Interesse an Autos: Kein Muss, aber definitiv ein Plus, denn du wirst viel mit Fahrzeugdaten arbeiten.
Entrepreneurial Mindset: Du hast Lust auf ein Umfeld, in dem sich Dinge schnell bewegen, zeigst Eigeninitiative und willst aktiv mitgestalten statt nur Dienst nach Vorschrift zu leisten.
Verfügbarkeit: Du hast 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit für uns, in den Semesterferien gerne mehr.
Sprachkenntnisse: Du beherrschst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) und Englisch sicher in Wort und Schrift.


Why Aampere?

Wachstum & Ownership: Du bekommst vom ersten Tag an echte Verantwortung, triffst eigene Entscheidungen und wirst als vollwertiges Teammitglied behandelt: im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du entsprechend schnell aufsteigen. Student steht auf dem Vertrag, nicht auf deiner Rolle.
Urban Sports Club oder Job Ticket: healthy team, happy team
Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats)
Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what's next?
Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im angrenzenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten: direkt neben dem Aampere-Büro und mit Blick auf das Riesenrad.
Chance auf Übernahme: Wenn du besonders gut bist, wollen wir, dass du bleibst. Denk von Anfang an nicht daran, wo das endet, sondern wo es hinführen könnte.


Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn...

...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind.
...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten.
...du einen fertigen Plan brauchst, bevor du loslegst. Seed Stage heißt: vieles ist unklar und ändert sich wöchentlich. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, im Ungewissen zu entscheiden und unterwegs zu korrigieren.
...du in deiner Lane bleiben willst. "Das ist nicht mein Job" kennen wir nicht. Du packst da an, wo es brennt, auch wenn es außerhalb deiner Rollenbeschreibung liegt.
...du einen klassischen 9-to-5-Job willst. Wir bauen etwas Großes und das geht nicht nebenbei. Wer hier ist, will Vollgas geben, statt nur die Zeit abzusitzen.


Wie wir arbeiten

Drei Werte, keine Poster an der Wand, sondern wie wir täglich arbeiten, einstellen und wachsen:

Aaudacity. Wir sind mutig genug, Risiken einzugehen, und schnell genug, es nicht halbherzig zu tun.
Aambition to grow. Wir wollen wachsen, als Menschen und als Unternehmen.
Aampact over Hierarchy. Die beste Idee gewinnt, egal von wem sie kommt. Titel entscheiden hier keine Diskussion.


Noch ein paar Worte zum Abschluss

Bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns über Deine formlose Bewerbung - alles weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam.

Egal, welchen Hintergrund, welche Herkunft oder welche Geschlechtsidentität du mitbringst – bei uns zählt, wer du als Person bist. Wir fördern eine Kultur des Respekts und Miteinanders, in der jede Stimme gehört wird, persönliche Weiterentwicklung möglich ist und Wertschätzung an erster Stelle steht.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager (m/w/d) – Core Team
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Wir bauen die Software, mit der Mieterstromprojekte laufen: Zählerdaten rein, Abrechnung raus, und alles dazwischen. Das Core Team verantwortet das Betreiberportal, das Produkt, auf dem der laufende Betrieb unserer Kunden steht. Es ist unser fachlich tiefstes Team, und es wächst.

Das Betreiberportal ist kein generisches SaaS. Es bildet die Energiewirtschaft ab: Messstellenbetrieb, Marktkommunikation, Netzentgelte, Umlagen, Abrechnung nach Regeln, die der Gesetzgeber schreibt und regelmäßig ändert. Wer hier priorisiert, muss verstehen, was eine Anforderung für den Betreiber wirtschaftlich bedeutet und was passiert, wenn sie falsch umgesetzt wird.

Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die das Team führt und das Geschäft dahinter versteht. Nicht als Durchreiche für Tickets und nicht als Architekt, der alles selbst entscheidet, sondern als jemand, der Business-Anforderungen in technische Entscheidungen übersetzt und dafür sorgt, dass gute Entwickler gute Arbeit machen können: klare Ziele, wenig Reibung, ehrliches Feedback, verlässliche Lieferung.

Der Weg dahin ist bewusst gewählt: Du startest für rund sechs Monate als Entwickler im Core Team. Du baust Features, machst Reviews und lernst Codebasis, Fachlichkeit und Menschen von innen kennen. Danach übernimmst du die Führung des Teams. Wer ein Team führen will, das er nie von innen gesehen hat, führt es an dem vorbei, was zählt.

Technisch: Python mit Django und Django Ninja im Backend, React mit TypeScript im Frontend, PostgreSQL mit TimescaleDB, deployt auf Kubernetes per GitOps mit ArgoCD. KI-Coding-Assistenten sind fester Teil des Workflows. In den ersten Monaten schreibst du diesen Code selbst. Danach musst du ihn weiter lesen können und verstehen, worüber dein Team diskutiert.

In den ersten sechs Monaten

  • Du arbeitest als Entwickler im Core Team: Features end-to-end, Reviews, Deployments, Support-Fälle. Ohne Sonderrolle

  • Du lernst die Fachlichkeit von Messkonzept bis Abrechnung und die Geschichte der Codebasis, inklusive der Stellen, an denen sie weh tut

  • Du baust Vertrauen zu den Menschen im Team auf, weil du mit ihnen arbeitest und nicht über ihnen

Danach

  • Du führst das Core Team: Einstellung, Onboarding, 1:1s, Entwicklung, Feedback. Die Menschen im Team sind deine erste Verantwortung

  • Du verantwortest die Lieferung: Zusammen mit Product priorisierst du nach wirtschaftlichem Wert und regulatorischem Druck, planst realistisch und sorgst dafür, dass Zugesagtes fertig wird

  • Du bringst Fachverständnis in die Produktentscheidungen ein: Du erkennst, wann eine Anforderung aus dem Markt kommt, wann aus einem einzelnen Kunden, und wann aus einem Missverständnis

  • Du hältst die technische Qualität hoch, ohne selbst der Flaschenhals zu sein: Du moderierst Architekturentscheidungen, forderst Tests und Reviews ein und schaffst Raum für Refactoring

  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zu Product, Support und den anderen Engineering-Teams, und du löst Konflikte, bevor sie im Sprint landen

  • Du machst Probleme sichtbar: Wenn etwas nicht klappt, sagst du es früh und mit Vorschlag statt spät und mit Ausrede

  • Du gestaltest Prozesse so, dass sie dem Team dienen, und schaffst die ab, die es nicht tun


Dein Profil

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als Softwareentwickler mit Web-Anwendungen in Produktion. Du kannst in Django und React produktiv arbeiten oder dich in wenigen Wochen dort einfinden

  • Erfahrung in der Führung eines Entwicklungsteams, als Engineering Manager, Team Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit Personalverantwortung

  • Background in better-for-you food, functional food, private-label NPD, or a fast-growing consumer brand.

Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Bei unserem Kunden handelt es sich um ein etabliertes Unternehmen, das seit rund 40 Jahren individuelle technische Schutz- und Einhausungslösungen für industrielle Anwendungen entwickelt und realisiert. Die Kunden kommen aus unterschiedlichsten Industriebereichen und umfassen sowohl Anlagen- und Maschinenhersteller als auch Betreiber industrieller Produktionsstätten.

Das Unternehmen versteht sich als kompetenter Komplettanbieter und bietet seinen Kunden eine ganzheitliche Betreuung – von der individuellen Planung und Auslegung über die Fertigung und Lieferung bis hin zur fachgerechten Montage.

Dank der langjährigen Erfahrung, des umfassenden Know-hows und der internationalen Ausrichtung ist das Unternehmen weltweit tätig. Lieferung und Montage der modernen Lösungen erfolgen sowohl national als auch international.

Aufgaben

HR Generalist - Stabilität schaffen, Veränderung gestalten

Sie suchen eine anspruchsvolle HR-Aufgabe, bei der Sie nicht einfach bestehende Prozesse verwalten, sondern in einer Phase der Neuausrichtung wirklich etwas bewegen können? Sie möchten Ihre Erfahrung einbringen, auch in schwierigen Etappen Orientierung geben und gemeinsam mit dem Unternehmen tragfähige Lösungen entwickeln?

Dann bietet diese Position eine interessante Möglichkeit: Sie begleiten ein etabliertes, international agierendes Unternehmen in einer Phase der Weiterentwicklung und Veränderung. Dabei gilt es, bestehende Strukturen und Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln, neue Perspektiven einzubringen und gemeinsam tragfähige Lösungen zu schaffen. Die Position bietet Ihnen dafür den notwendigen Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, mit Ihrer Erfahrung nachhaltige Impulse zu setzen.

Als HR Generalist übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle dabei, das Unternehmen durch diesen Entwicklungsprozess zu begleiten und gleichzeitig die Grundlage für die weitere Entwicklung zu schaffen. Dabei geht es um deutlich mehr als die klassische operative Personalarbeit. Gefragt sind ein gutes Gespür für Menschen und Situationen, die Fähigkeit, auch bei unterschiedlichen Interessen den Überblick zu behalten, sowie der Mut, bestehende Strukturen und Prozesse zu hinterfragen und weiterzuentwickeln.

Sie arbeiten eng mit der Geschäftsführung und den Führungskräften zusammen, sind Ansprechpartner für die Mitarbeitenden und übernehmen Verantwortung für eine professionelle und verlässliche Personalarbeit. Dabei gilt es, operative Themen sicher zu steuern, gleichzeitig aber auch die notwendigen Veränderungen im HR aktiv mitzugestalten.

Qualifikation

Für diese gestaltungsstarke Position suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit im HR, die fachliche Kompetenz mit unternehmerischem Denken und einem ausgeprägten Gespür für Menschen und Organisation verbindet.

Erfahrung in der operativen Personalarbeit – von Recruiting und Bewerbungsgesprächen über Arbeitsverträge und personalbezogene Dokumente bis hin zur Zusammenarbeit mit dem Steuerbüro in der Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung – bildet dabei eine wichtige fachliche Grundlage. Ebenso gehören die Analyse von Gehaltsentwicklungen und Benefits, die Planung von Weiterbildungen sowie die Begleitung von Mitarbeitergesprächen zu Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich.

Sie verstehen es, unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzuführen, vertrauensvoll mit Führungskräften, Mitarbeitenden und dem Betriebsrat zusammenzuarbeiten und auch in herausfordernden Situationen souverän zu agieren. Gleichzeitig bringen Sie die Bereitschaft mit, aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung der Unternehmenskultur und an Maßnahmen zur Stabilisierung des Betriebsklimas mitzuwirken.

Benefits

Die Möglichkeit, wirklich etwas zu bewegen!

Diese Position bietet Ihnen die Möglichkeit, HR aktiv mitzugestalten und dabei sichtbare Veränderungen zu bewirken. Sie treffen auf bestehende Strukturen und Prozesse, die weiterentwickelt werden können, und erhalten den Freiraum, eigene Ideen einzubringen, neue Ansätze einzubringen und diese gemeinsam mit dem Unternehmen umzusetzen.

Mehr Freiraum – auch im Arbeitsalltag

Neben der außergewöhnlichen Gestaltungsmöglichkeit bietet die Position eine 4-Tage-Woche auf 36-Stunden-Basis – für mehr Freiraum und eine ausgewogene Balance zwischen beruflicher Verantwortung und persönlicher Zeit.

Nutzen Sie die Chance, in einer anspruchsvollen Unternehmensphase eine Schlüsselrolle in der Veränderung zu übernehmen. Gemeinsam mit dem Unternehmen schaffen Sie klare und tragfähige HR-Strukturen, professionalisieren Prozesse und leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag dazu, die Organisation für die Zukunft aufzustellen.

Wenn Sie Freude daran haben, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Veränderungen aktiv mitzugestalten und Ihre Ideen dort einzubringen, wo sie tatsächlich etwas bewirken können, bietet diese Position eine besondere Möglichkeit.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung und darauf, Sie kennenzulernen.
