jobs.title: Junior Customer Success Specialist (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Your mission

Purpose of the role

The Junior Customer Success Manager keeps single-store restaurants live, transacting and growing on SIDES. The role works a large book of scaled accounts, mostly through campaigns and signals rather than scheduled calls, and steps in personally when something moves: a store goes silent, a termination arrives, a customer becomes eligible for an upgrade.

It is the entry point into Customer Success. The role is built so that someone new to SaaS can learn the craft on clear processes, and grow into owning a book of their own.

Key responsibilities:

Activation and activity:

  • Follow up on new accounts from onboarding handover until they transact regularly, with a focus on the first 90 days
  • Work the silent-store list every week: accounts that are online in the CRM but show no transactions
  • Help customers adopt the modules they already pay for

Retention:

  • Contact every customer in the book whose termination arrives, within two working days, and document the reason
  • Run the first save conversation using the save playbook (pause, downgrade, fee removal, technical fix, discount last) and hand complex cases to a senior colleague
  • Clear the termination date in the CRM when a save succeeds

Expansion:

  • Run the evergreen upsell campaigns on the book together with Marketing, and follow up on responses
  • Qualify interest in SIDES Pay, webshop, loyalty and driver modules and close standard upgrades
  • Use tier and rate changes as the entry point for an upsell conversation

Day to day:

  • Answer customer success enquiries on the book in Zoho Desk and the CRM, and route pure support issues to Support without taking them over
  • Keep every interaction documented in the CRM
  • Flag recurring product issues to the Team Lead with ticket references

Your profile

Required:

  • First experience in a customer-facing role: customer success, account management, inside sales, support or hospitality
  • Clear, friendly and persistent on the phone
  • Organised enough to work a large book through lists and signals
  • Comfortable with a CRM and with numbers
  • Fluent German (DACH book) or Dutch (BENELUX book), good English

Desirable:

  • Experience in restaurants, delivery or retail
  • First experience with a SaaS product or payment product

Perks & Benefits

Our Benefits:

  • A recipe for success: With over a decade of experience in the gastronomy and delivery industry, SIDES is known as a true specialist in this field. Join a leading player and help shape the future of the market.
  • Ownership & impact: We give you the space to bring in your ideas, grow your strengths, and take real responsibility. You’ll work independently while being supported by a strong and collaborative team.
  • High-quality work setup: Modern hardware, ergonomic workstations, and a professional office environment ensure you can do your best work.
  • Hungry for growth: Continuous learning matters to us. Through regular feedback cycles, we actively support your personal and professional development.
  • A positive workplace culture: Enjoy a welcoming atmosphere, a trusting team culture, and our well-connected office in the heart of Berlin (Südkreuz).

Workplace Environment Perks:

  • Central office location in Berlin
  • Regular office and team events
  • Snacks and drinks in the office
  • SIDES Library
  • Dog-friendly workplace
  • Onboarding lunch to help you settle in and connect with the team

Your Benefits:

  • €50 monthly benefit allowance - your choice:
    • JobRad
    • Deutschlandticket
    • Company pension scheme (bAV)
    • Wellhub
  • Urban Sports Club: Discounted membership with access to fitness, classes, and wellness activities.
  • Instahelp: Professional mental health support, available whenever you need it.
  • INCENT & Corporate Benefits: Attractive employee discounts and exclusive partner offers.
  • Hybrid work: A mix of office and home office, depending on your role and team.
  • Flexible working hours: Working hours that fit your daily life and offer real flexibility.
  • December 24th & 31st off: Fully off without deducting vacation days.
  • Company events: Our annual highlights - the SIDES Summer Party and our Christmas Get-together.

jobs.title: Process Engineer - Semiconductor Processes
jobs.description:
Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. 

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Role Overview 

We are looking for a Process Engineer to support the development, stabilization and industrialization of our semiconductor fabrication processes. 

At our current stage of maturity, this position combines advanced process development, hands-on R&D and manufacturing engineering. The Process Engineer will play a key role in bridging the gap between Advanced R&D and Production, transforming newly developed process building blocks into robust, repeatable and scalable manufacturing processes. 

The role will have a strong focus on dry etching processes, particularly ICP and RIE, as well as PECVD and metal evaporation. The successful candidate will work closely with R&D teams, fabrication engineers, equipment owners and cleanroom operators to improve process capability, reproducibility, yield and production throughput. 

This is a highly hands-on position requiring a strong understanding of semiconductor fabrication, rigorous experimental methodology and the ability to investigate complex interactions between process parameters and device performance. 

Key Responsibilities 

Process Development & Industrialization 

  • Develop, optimize and stabilize semiconductor fabrication processes, with a primary focus on ICP / RIE dry etching, PECVD deposition and metal evaporation. 
  • Validate and qualify new fabrication equipment and associated processes. 
  • Define process windows, recipes, operating conditions and acceptance criteria. 
  • Use structured experimentation, including Design of Experiments (DoE) where appropriate, to understand process sensitivities and optimize performance. 
  • Improve process repeatability, reproducibility, robustness and within-wafer / wafer-to-wafer homogeneity. 
  • Prepare processes and equipment for increasing wafer sizes, batch sizes and production volumes. 

R&D to Production Transfer 

  • Act as a key technical interface between Advanced R&D and Production. 
  • Convert R&D process building blocks into stable, documented and manufacturable processes. 
  • Assess manufacturability, scalability and process risks before transfer to production. 
  • Define qualification plans and acceptance criteria before releasing new or modified processes to production. 
  • Lead or contribute to Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) for critical fabrication steps, identifying potential failure modes, their effects on device performance and appropriate prevention and control measures. 
  • Translate PFMEA outcomes into process controls, monitoring plans, acceptance criteria, Control Plans and documentation. 
  • Support technology transfer through clear documentation, operator training and technical communication. 

Process Control & Yield Improvement 

  • Monitor and improve production process performance, yield and throughput. 
  • Establish regular process checks, controls and monitoring methodologies, including Statistical Process Control (SPC) where relevant. 
  • Detect process drifts, investigate deviations and define corrective and preventive actions. 
  • Lead root-cause analysis and troubleshooting activities for yield losses, process excursions and equipment-related issues. 
  • Define and maintain relevant process KPIs and contribute to continuous-improvement initiatives. 
  • Promote best practices that increase process stability, repeatability and equipment utilization. 

Equipment & Production Support 

  • Provide hands-on technical support to cleanroom operators and production teams. 
  • Support equipment qualification, troubleshooting and process recovery following equipment interventions. 
  • Work closely with equipment suppliers and internal teams to resolve technical issues. 
  • Contribute to a safe, disciplined and efficient cleanroom environment. 

Process Characterization & Data Analysis 

  • Characterize the impact of fabrication parameters on material and device performance. 
  • Correlate process data with structural, optical and electrical characterization results. 
  • Use experimental data to identify process sensitivities, failure mechanisms and optimization opportunities. 
  • Develop appropriate data-analysis tools to support process monitoring and engineering decisions. 
  • Search and analyze scientific and technical literature to support process development and troubleshooting. 

Documentation & Communication 

  • Create and maintain high-quality process documentation, including process specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), equipment recipes, qualification reports, Control Plans, process-development reports and troubleshooting guides. 
  • Ensure frequent and clear reporting of process status, experimental results, risks and improvement actions. 
  • Communicate effectively with colleagues from different technical backgrounds and levels of experience. 
  • Train and support operators and other team members on new or updated processes. 

Requirements

Required Qualifications & Experience 

  • Master's degree or PhD in Semiconductor Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Micro/Nanotechnology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor or photonic-device fabrication in a cleanroom environment. 
  • Strong knowledge of dry etching, ideally including hands-on experience with ICP-RIE. 
  • Experience with one or more complementary processes such as RIE, PECVD, physical vapor deposition / metal evaporation and lithography. 
  • Strong understanding of how fabrication parameters can influence material properties and device performance. 
  • Excellent attention to detail and a rigorous approach to experimental work. 
  • Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and problem-solving skills. 
  • Ability to independently investigate technical problems using experimental data and scientific literature. 
  • Strong communication and documentation skills. 
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience in a semiconductor manufacturing, pilot-line or production environment. 
  • Experience with process industrialization and transfer from R&D to production. 
  • Experience with PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, DoE or other structured process-risk and continuous-improvement methodologies. 
  • Experience with optical and electrical characterization of semiconductor or optoelectronic devices. 
  • Experience with III-V semiconductor devices, particularly AlGaAs-based photonic structures, resonators or VCSEL-type technologies. 
  • Knowledge of Python or other programming languages for process-data analysis, automated reporting, instrument control or experimental automation. 

Profile 

We are looking for someone who combines the mindset of an R&D engineer with the rigor of a manufacturing/process engineer. 

The ideal candidate is comfortable developing new processes where all parameters are not yet fully understood, while also being able to transform experimental processes into stable, controlled and documented production workflows. 

You should enjoy working directly in the cleanroom, analyzing data, solving complex fabrication problems and collaborating across R&D and production teams. 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

    • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')
    • Hiring Manager Interview (45')
    • Use Case / Practical Assessment : The use case will consist of a simple practical exercise focused on the alignment of an optical bench. The assessment will take place in the cleanroom, they are not considered PPE for this exercise.
    • Meeting with the teams
    • 2 reference check
    • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome.

jobs.title: Fiber Pigtailing Engineer (Master level)
jobs.description:
Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient quantum processing units that scale, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. 

With a team of more than 140 people, we develop our own hardware and software stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to quantum control systems and quantum algorithms.

Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation using Quandela's cutting-edge quantum dot technology.

Achieving this vision requires not only advances in photonic quantum computing, but also the development of scalable spin-photon interfaces, distributed entanglement capabilities and future SPOQC (Spin-Optical Quantum Computing) architectures that will enable modular and fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

About this position:

Join Quandela’s Source Production team to work on the fiber pigtailing of single-photon sources.
The role focuses on developing, improving and operating highly precise fiber coupling methods for photonic quantum devices.

The role is part of the Source Production team, which currently includes 11 people across fabrication, fiber pigtailing and optical characterization. The role is part of the pigtail team, currently composed of one person, and works in close interaction with the fabrication and characterization teams.

The objective is to improve the reliability, reproducibility and productivity of the pigtailing process, from prototype development to production-ready methods.

Key responsibilities

  • Perform high-precision fiber coupling between single-mode fibers and individual micropillars, with alignment precision below 100 nm 
  • Work on fiber preparation and assembly steps, including: 
    • fiber cleaving 
    • fiber gluing 
    • fiber mounting with ferrules and holders 
    • fabrication of structures on fiber tips 
    • anti-reflection coating treatment 
  • Develop and improve methods to evaluate coupling and alignment quality through clear metrics
  • Cool down pigtailed sources and support the validation of the assembled devices
  • Perform optical characterization of quantum emitters using quantum optics techniques, including single-photon detection
  • Contribute to the development of reliable and reproducible production procedures
  • Write systematic reports and share production feedback with other teams
  • Work closely with the fabrication and optical characterization teams
  • Contribute to productivity improvements and risk mitigation in the pigtailing process
  • Simulation experience is a plus 

Requirements

Desired profile

Required

Engineering degree in optics, photonics, optomechanics, experimental physics or a related field

  • Strong hands-on experience in optics and optical alignment
  • Experience with fiber coupling, fiber handling or fiber-based optical systems
  • Good understanding of photonic structures and optical components
  • Experience with cryogenic systems or low-temperature optical setups
  • Ability to work with high precision and follow established procedures
  • Good communication and reporting skills
  • Good level of English

Nice to have

  • Experience with quantum emitters or single-photon sources
  • Simulation experience is a plus 
  • Good balance between hands-on and simulation, ideally around 70% hands-on / 30% simulation

Soft skills

  • Very precise and rigorous
  • Strong respect for procedures
  • Creative when developing new methods
  • Reliable and methodical
  • Good risk mitigation mindset
  • Team player
  • Hands-on and practical

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience

  • 100% health coverage (Alan)

  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

jobs.title: Senior Communications Manager
jobs.description:
Skeleton Technologies is looking for a Senior Communications Manager to join our team.

About Skeleton

Skeleton Technologies is a global leader in critical power infrastructure for AI data centers and electrical grid stability, founded in 2009. Power today is more than electricity.

It is national security, digital continuity, and economic resilience. Skeleton is the Backbone of Power: equipping AI data centers, electrical grids, defense systems, and critical infrastructure with the resilience to withstand surges, instability, and failure. Our power systems protect GPU clusters from millisecond-level spikes, enable hyperscalers to run at higher rack densities without grid compromise, and make AI data centers up to more 40% energy efficient. We keep the lights on when grids fluctuate, stabilising electrical infrastructure under the combined pressure of accelerating renewable energy deployment and surging AI demand.

When power fails, critical operations stop. We exist to prevent that in microseconds. Powering the infrastructure that powers everything else.

Responsibilities

  • Own Skeleton's global external communications. This is an external-facing role focused on media, analysts, executive visibility and partner communications, as an individual contributor reporting to the VP of Marketing.
  • Draft and manage press releases, customer and partner announcements, and proactive media outreach globally, with a focus on Europe and North America.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for inbound press and analyst inquiries, coordinating timely, accurate responses in line with company messaging.
  • Prepare executives (CEO, CPO and other spokespeople as needed) for interviews, briefings and press events, including message coaching and Q&A preparation.
  • Work directly with the CEO on media opportunities, executive visibility and thought leadership.
  • Identify, secure and manage earned and paid speaking opportunities for company leadership at industry conferences, summits and trade events.
  • Build and maintain a customer communications program, including joint press releases, testimonials and co-marketing announcements with strategic partners and customers.
  • Share ownership of overall strategic messaging and communications direction with the wider marketing and communications team, ensuring consistency across press, customer and partner communications.
  • Maintain and grow relationships with Tier-1 journalists and industry analysts covering energy storage, data center infrastructure and industrial technology.
  • Manage Skeleton's presence on X as a channel for media engagement and journalist relationships.
  • Monitor media coverage, industry narrative trends and relevant EU and North American policy developments (AI data centers, grid stabilization, defense), flagging opportunities and risks proactively.
  • Coordinate embargoes, approvals and sign-off processes for joint announcements with technology and commercial partners.

Requirements

  • 10–15 years of experience in corporate communications, public relations or media relations, including in-house experience at a fast-growing startup or scale-up.
  • Background in B2B technology, ideally energy, power grids, energy storage, data center infrastructure, industrial technology or a related deep-tech sector.
  • An existing network of Tier-1 journalists and industry analysts in Europe and North America, with the ability to secure meaningful press engagement from day one.
  • Experience working with North American media is required, including for candidates based in Europe.
  • Proven track record of Tier-1 media coverage, press releases, executive interview preparation, and proactive and reactive media outreach for a global or multi-region company.
  • Experience securing and managing speaking opportunities (earned and paid) at industry conferences and events.
  • Experience managing joint and partner communications, including co-branded press releases and customer testimonials.
  • Strong awareness of the energy and technology landscape, as well as EU and North American politics and policy.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities change quickly, working directly with the CEO and senior leadership, with occasional availability outside standard hours.
  • Persistence and confidence in driving internal approvals and pushing for timely decisions from senior stakeholders.
  • Comfortable operating across time zones and markets in Europe and North America.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; any other languages is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations or a related field (or equivalent professional experience) is a plus.

Benefits

  • We offer flexible working hours, with the possibility of mobile working without core working hours and sufficient freedom for your own ideas.
  • A flat hierarchy culture - fostering our great working atmosphere.
  • A motivating opportunity for continuous growth at Skeleton.
  • An additional day off every year for your birthday.

Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Projektteams und Delivery Management sorgst du dafür, dass komplexe Kundenaccounts erfolgreich gesteuert werden.


Aufgaben

  • Du steuerst große Kundenaccounts mit mehreren parallelen IT- und Softwareentwicklungsprojekten und behältst Termine, Budgets, Qualität und Risiken im Gesamtblick. 
  • Du steuerst und unterstützt die Projektteams innerhalb deines Accounts und förderst deren fachliche Weiterentwicklung im Rahmen der laufenden Projekte.
  • Du setzt ein wirksames Risikomanagement um und stellst sicher, dass Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Eskalationen frühzeitig erkannt, bewertet und adressiert werden.

About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to join our Authentication and Authorisation team where you'll be responsible for the strategy, delivery and outcomes for the Pleo’s product IAM.

This is a highly complex space with a legacy custom-built service and a future-state platform, currently being implemented in our Enterprise rewrite.

Success in this role means defining and executing a sensible migration path between SMB and Enterprise architectures and modernising our current auth capabilities while maintaining high security, compliance, performance and trust.

Who you'll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our VP of Engineering and you’ll lead, mentor and grow a team of 6- 10 software engineers. You’ll work closely with Product, Security, Compliance and Core Platform teams to align priorities and manage dependencies, and you’ll collaborate across the wider Backend & Infrastructure group to keep technical direction and platform standards coherent.

Ultimately, your role is to foster an environment where engineers can do their best work and grow - as individuals and as a team - by setting clear expectations, ensuring our ways of working enable delivery (rather than slowing it down) and holding a high bar for quality.



What you'll be doing

As an Engineering Manager, you will:

  • Own the vision, strategy and execution roadmap for identity, authentication and authorisation across SMB and Enterprise.

  • Drive delivery and outcomes for the Authentication & Authorisation team, ensuring we build secure, scalable systems the whole platform can rely on.

  • Successfully roll out a new identity platform across our Enterprise offerings.

  • Define and execute a pragmatic migration strategy between the SMB legacy service and the Enterprise architecture.

Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale. The platform combines a marketplace, workflow automation, and operational analytics, and is built to handle the volume and compliance demands of social housing, local authority property portfolios, and large-scale residential operations.


We are headquartered in London and our team works across Europe.


We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you are interested in working on hard, real-world problems in a sector that has long been under-served by good software, we would like to hear from you.

The Role

We are hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to build the product surfaces that housing providers, contractors, and residents use every day. This is a fully remote position; we currently have remote engineers based in the UK, Germany, Turkey, Poland, Italy, Spain, and Portugal. You will report to a Team Lead, a hands-on engineer who still writes code and has a small number of engineers reporting to them, and work alongside product managers, designers, backend engineers, and data analysts.


Our frontend is built on TypeScript, React, React Router, TanStack Query, MaterialUI and BaseUI, against an increasingly service-oriented backend built in Django REST Framework and PostgreSQL. The codebase is large but clean, because we put real weight on design patterns, readability, testability, maintainability, and extendability.


The engineering team sits at the centre of what Plentific does, and the problems are genuinely difficult: online payments, quoting, invoicing, booking, search and scoring algorithms, in-app messaging, real-time notifications, and fraud prevention. Much of it is high-volume and messy legacy integrations, complex permissions, strict compliance requirements, and users who need software to fit how work actually happens on the ground. We expect you to apply engineering judgement to these problems rather than only writing the code in front of you, and to treat agentic, spec-driven development as a normal part of how you work rather than an experiment.


Success in this role means shipping interfaces that are fast, accessible, and well-tested, raising the standard of the frontend codebase around you, and leaving the engineers you work with better than you found them.

Key Responsibilities

Frontend Engineering

  • Build and maintain product interfaces in TypeScript, React, TanStack Query, React Router, MaterialUI and BaseUI across our web applications.

  • Translate product requirements and design concepts into technical documents that set out scope, system behaviour, edge cases, and high-level technical analysis.

  • Design component APIs, state management, and data-fetching patterns that stay readable and extendable as the codebase grows.

  • Integrate against REST APIs in a service-oriented architecture, shaping the contracts with backend engineers rather than accepting whatever is offered.

  • Review, refactor, and retire existing code so it meets the requirements of improved or new features.

Performance, Quality, and Reliability

  • Diagnose and resolve page load, rendering, and other frontend performance problems.

  • Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests that give the team confidence to ship frequently.

  • Instrument frontend observability with tools such as Sentry, Grafana Logs or New Relic, and act on what they show.

  • Debug and fix production issues across our applications, including the integration points where frontend and backend behaviour diverge.

  • Design against common frontend security risks, including XSS and CSRF.

Agentic and Spec-Driven Development

  • Turn ambiguous product ideas into implementation-ready specs, including user flows, component behaviour, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and test expectations.

  • Prototype interfaces and interaction quickly, using working software to test feasibility and product value before committing to larger delivery.

  • Use agentic coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent to generate, refactor, test, and review code within clear technical constraints.

  • Evaluate AI-generated code critically for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, accessibility, and fit with Plentific's architecture.

  • Improve the team's spec-driven development practice through reusable prompt patterns, review checklists, examples, and lightweight documentation.

Collaboration and Craft

  • Partner with product managers, designers, and backend engineers from problem framing through release, applying engineering judgement to improve the user experience before implementation starts.

  • Collaborate with other engineers through code review and pair programming.

  • Define and communicate frontend standards and best practice, and hold the team to them in review.

  • Write concise technical documentation covering components, algorithms, APIs, and operational handover.

  • Articulate technical trade-offs in plain English to technical and non-technical colleagues, including when scope, quality, or delivery timing needs to change.

Requirements

  • Expert-level TypeScript and modern JavaScript, with deep command of React and the patterns around it, including data fetching, routing, and component libraries.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including design patterns, testing, debugging, and code that stays readable and extendable at scale.

  • Sound grasp of UI, UX and accessibility considerations, with the judgement to improve a design before building it rather than implement it exactly as drawn.

  • Demonstrable experience diagnosing and fixing page load, rendering, and other frontend performance problems.

  • Working knowledge of frontend observability with Sentry, Grafana logs, or New Relic, and of CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions or ArgoCD.

  • Practical awareness of common frontend security risks, including XSS and CSRF, and how to design against them.

  • Strong working fluency with agentic coding tools and spec-driven development workflows, including specification writing, code generation, test generation, and critical review.

  • Clear communication, with the ability to articulate technical concepts and trade-offs in plain English.

  • High ambition and a strong sense of urgency, with the drive to deliver an ambitious product roadmap at pace using AI, and a positive, can-do attitude.

Experience and Qualifications

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 5+ years of commercial React and TypeScript.

  • Experience shipping and operating production frontends for customer-facing SaaS products, including monitoring, incident response, and performance improvement.

  • Experience working in a large, long-lived codebase where design patterns, testability, and maintainability genuinely matter.

  • Experience consuming and shaping REST APIs in a service-oriented architecture, ideally backed by Django REST Framework or an equivalent.

  • Experience working in cross-functional teams with product managers and designers on shared customer outcomes, not only technical delivery.

  • Experience using AI coding tools in a professional software delivery workflow, ideally within a spec-driven development framework.

Benefits

We offer:

  • A salary package aligned to the role and market

  • 25 days annual holiday, plus one additional day for every year served, up to a maximum of 5 additional days

  • Fully remote working, including the option to work abroad

  • Private healthcare for you and your immediate family, with discounted gym membership and access to optical, dental, and private GP services

About Us

Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale. The platform combines a marketplace, workflow automation, and operational analytics, and is built to handle the volume and compliance demands of social housing, local authority property portfolios, and large-scale residential operations.

We are headquartered in London, with engineering and operations across the UK and Germany. Our investors include Highland Europe, Brookfield, Mubadala, RXR Digital Ventures, and Target Global.

The Role

Every repair, appointment, compliance certificate and invoice on the platform leaves data behind. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager, Data and Insights to own what we do with it. The remit covers the whole chain: the data model, pipelines and warehouse underneath, the reporting our clients use to run their portfolios, the datasets behind our AI features, and the features that act on what the data shows. That last part matters most. You will be measured on what changes as a result of the data, not on what it reports.

You will sit in the Product team and report to the Head of Product. You will work most closely with data engineering, analytics and data science, and with the product managers who own repairs, compliance and contractors. You will also spend time with the client-facing and operations teams, who work with this data daily and hear directly from clients about it. We expect you to use AI in your own work: prototyping with agentic tools, writing specs engineers can build from, testing model output against a real eval set, and knowing when a person needs to stay in the loop.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy and Commercial Ownership

  • Own the direction and strategy for Plentific's data and insight products, from the internal data model through to what clients see.

  • Align the data roadmap with Plentific's AI roadmap and commercial goals, judging each investment on the operational and financial return it earns.

  • Grow the commercial value of data inside existing client relationships, through analytics tiers, data services and APIs for the housing providers and local authorities we already serve.

Client-Facing Analytics and Insight to Action

  • Define the compliance, repairs performance and spend reporting that client organisations depend on to run their portfolios.

  • Identify where predictive models turn years of historical maintenance data into a forecast someone can act on.

  • Ship platform features that act on the insight, and hold them to the outcomes they were meant to shift.

  • Own each data product end-to-end, from discovery through to launch and iteration, with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, designers and other product managers.

Requirements

  • Practical grasp of data quality engineering, including testing, lineage, freshness monitoring, and the design of data contracts between producers and consumers.

  • Working knowledge of evaluation for machine learning features, including held-out eval sets, error asymmetry, confidence thresholds, drift monitoring in production, and the design of human-in-the-loop controls.

jobs.title: Founding Head of Brand
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Founding Head of Brand to own how Pairs presents itself to founders and investors: its positioning, voice and visual identity, and the writing and video behind them.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

The role

This is our first full-time brand hire. You set the brand strategy and you run it: what Pairs says, where it says it, how it looks, and the impression a founder or investor forms before they ever speak to us.

Most weeks, that means one or two high-value posts in the founders' voices and one or two from the company. You also run story shoots with the founders and investors we work with, from booking the guest to the final cut, and you edit the video yourself.

We already hold a library of recorded founder and investor interviews. A large part of this role is turning that material into content people want to watch, and finding creative new ways to use it: films, series, clips and formats we have not tried yet.

You also own our editorial output: a weekly newsletter that also lives on our site, a monthly newsletter, and a quarterly report we want to become a reference point for the market.

Everything is aimed at one outcome: how founders and investors perceive Pairs. Every post, film and report should reinforce a brand they trust before the first conversation.

You report to the two co-founders, shape the strategy with them directly, and have real creative freedom. You will make the work yourself from day one, and build a team around you as the brand grows.

What you will own

  • Brand identity. Positioning, voice and visual identity, held consistent across our site, our social channels and the press.

  • Editorial and social. Weekly founder and company posts on LinkedIn and X, both newsletters and the quarterly report. You write them and you publish them.

  • Our video library. Repurposing recorded founder and investor interviews into films, series and clips, and finding creative new ways to use the material.

  • Story shoots. New founder and investor shoots, from booking and preparation through the shoot to the final edit, which you cut yourself.

  • Brand perception. How founders and investors perceive Pairs, and how that perception improves over time.

You are a fit if you

  • Have built and run a brand end to end that we can review: a named brand where you set the voice, created the content, ran the channels, and can quote the results before and after.

  • Still create the work yourself. You write, edit video and direct shoots, and you can state precisely what you made and what you briefed out.

  • See more in existing footage than others do: new formats, series and cuts that give recorded material a second life.

  • Write to a high standard in a restrained register, with published work longer than a social caption.

  • Have managed people who make the work, whether a small team or freelancers, and are ready to build a team here over time.

Your Mission

exmox is an organization designed for rapid expansion, prioritizing results over complacency.

By joining us, you enter a high-stakes global arena, tackling complex challenges that demand continuous professional growth. We're looking for a Senior Fraud & Risk Analyst to strengthen exmox's fraud prevention and risk management capabilities. You'll bring hands-on experience detecting and mitigating fraud across different types of organizations, and you'll play a hybrid role: partnering closely with exmox's Fraud Analytics Team Lead on strategic initiatives, while also supporting the operations side through process changes, rollouts, and analysis.

What You’ll Own:

  • Investigate, analyze, and mitigate fraud patterns across user acquisition, transactions, and account activity, with particular attention to reward-based and incentivized user acquisition channels (offerwalls, referral programs, cashback/rewards mechanics) where fraud vectors are especially prevalent.

  • Act as a reliable second-in-command on risk management matters, able to step in for the Team Lead on ongoing projects, stakeholder updates, or urgent decisions when they are unavailable.

  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, quantify fraud exposure, and report findings and recommendations to leadership.

What You Bring

  • Relevant experience in fraud management or risk analysis, ideally with exposure to both a large/corporate environment and a fast-moving scale-up - you understand how fraud programs differ in maturity, tooling, and pace across those settings.
  • Direct experience with reward-based user acquisition fraud (offerwalls, referral abuse, incentivized installs, multi-accounting, device farms) is a strong plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, comfortable working with SQL and large datasets to investigate patterns and validate hypotheses.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate with a degree of ownership - comfortable proposing and driving initiatives, not just executing tasks.

jobs.title: Senior Conversion Design Analyst (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Your mission

We're looking for a Senior Conversion Design Analyst who is genuinely both things: a designer who digs into data, and an analyst who designs. You decide with evidence. You will frame real user problems based on qualitative and quantitative data, design a part of our product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and analyze the results yourself.

You will sit inside the product delivery team that focuses on user growth, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it. And you will not be doing it alone: You join a group of Conversion Design Analysts across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards.

English is our working language. German matters here too: You will be designing flows that German-speaking users read.

Concretely, you will:

  • Design experiences grounded in real user needs and real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that are highly usable and intuitive and that earn their place by adding measurable value, not just because we can build them.
  • Frame the real problem before solving it. Dig into quantitative and qualitative data until you find the actual question underneath the ask. Then make it explainable and actionable. A well-framed problem is half the battle
  • Design, run the experiment, read it honestly and decide what comes next. Define a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome. Then use what you learned to frame the next question. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, and designing the next step.
  • Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody.
  • Direct AI, and spend your judgment where it counts. AI produces a lot of our first-pass design. You will brief it, push back on it, and hold the quality bar, so your own hours go to the thinking a model cannot do.
  • Argue for cutting things. Adding is easy. You will help decide what earns its place and what should be removed, and be willing to make the case for less.

Your profile

  • You practice product design and analytics. You might come from an analyst background and bring a love of design and design thinking, or vice versa.
  • You have run experiments end to end and know how to move from one to the next. Setting up the hypothesis, designing strong variants using our design system, choosing the right metrics to track, analyzing the results and then making a clear call on how to continue: ship it, kill it, or iterate.
  • You have technical know-how and experience in setting up and evaluating experiments in an A/B testing tool, constructing the needed dashboards for the problem space you are working on.
  • With sufficient data literacy, you get your own numbers through SQL query. You work with raw data to dig up insights and spot opportunities, without waiting for someone else to pull it for you.
  • You have statistical literacy. You don’t need to be able to run R, but you understand what Bayesian vs. frequentist is about and why you do a power analysis before launching an experiment.
  • You care about craft and are attentive to details. You can tell the difference between good enough and actually good and you design experiences people do not have to think about.
  • You present your work clearly, defend your decisions when challenged, and are comfortable in front of a crowd.
  • You are fluent with AI tools. This role allows you to have more control and impact through both design and analysis, but to do this well you'll need to leverage (and at times extend) our AI enablement stack
  • Excellent English skills for working in our international team.

To apply, include a cover letter explaining why this role and why now and if your background doesn't tick every box, tell us how you'd bridge the gap. Alongside it, share a portfolio that shows your work through its impact, at least one project walked through end to end: the hypothesis, what you designed, the result, and what you took from it. Show us how you used data to move your thinking forward, and where experimentation shaped what you built. If you can't share a portfolio due to an NDA or the nature of your work, a detailed cover letter walking through a project in the same way is fine.

Nice to have

  • Experience with a marketplace, community, classifieds, or other network product.
  • Strong German, or the confidence to design in it with support.
  • Experience building or maintaining parts of a design system.
  • Comfortable writing SQL without AI assistance.
  • You have basic dbt knowledge.

What we offer

  • Hybrid work model combining office and remote days
  • A meaningful job – we're creating a great product with real added value for the community
  • Work in a cheerful and experienced team that exchanges ideas and learns from each other
  • Insights into the entire work process of our social startup and the nebenan.de foundation
  • Responsibility and great opportunities to actively contribute
  • Your nebenan.de SpenditCard – you'll receive an additional income of 35 Euros per month, which you can use for things of your choice
  • 30 days of vacation per year – we also offer the possibility of workation models and a sabbatical
  • A workplace in Berlin-Kreuzberg and regular events like yoga or Lunch & Learn sessions.

If we’ve captured your interest, apply now and let us know why you’re the perfect fit for the job!

jobs.description:
Gestalte deine Zukunft mit uns!

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in München suchen wir dich als (Senior) Consultant (m/w/d) in der Prüfung und/oder Beratung in unserem ÖPNV Team.

Schon in der Beratung, Prüfung oder Private Equity tätig? Perfekt…
Du hast (jahrelang) in einer Beratungs- oder Prüfungsgesellschaft, in einer M&A-Boutique oder im Private Equity-Umfeld gearbeitet, möchtest das gerne weiterhin tun, aber anders – z. B. ohne Arbeiten an Wochenenden und langen Arbeitstagen bis in die Nacht hinein? Gleichzeitig hast du Lust, dich zu spezialisieren, anstatt verschiedene Branchen nur oberflächlich kennenzulernen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen…

Erfahrung in der ÖPNV-Branche? Muss nicht …
Du kannst bei uns auch ohne bisherige Erfahrung in der ÖPNV-Branche starten – vorausgesetzt, Du hast Lust darauf, von erfahrenen Prüfern und Beratern zu lernen und interessierst Dich für die Mobilität von heute und morgen.

Tradition und Beständigkeit – aber trotzdem nicht von gestern?
Seit der Gründung der PKF IVT in den 70er Jahren sind wir ein verlässlicher Partner für große und kleinere Verkehrsunternehmen, Landkreise, Städte und Bundesländer in Deutschland und Österreich. Bei uns erwartet dich ein interdisziplinäres Team aus Wirtschaftsprüfern, Rechtsanwälten, Steuer-, IT- und Unternehmensberatern, das sich durch einen hohen Innovations- und Qualitätsanspruch kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt.

Büro, Homeoffice? Beides gerne …
Ob im Homeoffice oder vor Ort in München oder in Hannover: Hier richten wir uns ganz nach deinen persönlichen Lebensumständen!

Aufgaben

  • Nach der Einarbeitung übernimmst du in Abhängigkeit von deiner bisherigen Erfahrung die Projektverantwortung für Beratungs- und Prüfungsaufträge für unsere Mandanten.

  • Du wirkst eigenverantwortlich z.B. an folgenden Fragestellungen mit:

  • SPNV/ÖPNV-bezogene Sonderprüfungen,

  • Unternehmensplanungen und Wirtschaftlichkeitsanalysen,

  • Controlling-Konzepte für Verkehrsunternehmen,

  • Trennungsrechnungen zur Erfüllung beihilfenrechtlicher Vorgaben oder Überkompensationsprüfungen.

  • In einem dynamischen Umfeld baust du ein tiefes Branchenwissen auf, entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinen Kollegen neue Lösungen für unsere Mandanten und präsentierst deine Gedanken bei Veranstaltungen und in der Fachpresse.

  • Bei Interesse wirst du ebenfalls eigenverantwortlich im Rahmen von Prüfungs- und Beratungsaufträgen für Mandanten in anderen Branchen tätig

Qualifikation

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet.
  • Du konntest bereits mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer Beratungs- oder Prüfungsgesellschaft, in einer M&A-Boutique oder im Private Equity-Umfeld sammeln.
  • Ggf. bist du Wirtschaftsprüfer (m/w/d) oder angehender Wirtschaftsprüfer (m/w/d). Wir sind auch offen für internationale Examen, wie z.B. CFA, CISA.
  • Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in MS-Office (insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint) und kannst diese z.B. auch für Unternehmensplanungen und Wirtschaftlichkeitsanalysen zielgerichtet einsetzen.
  • Du überzeugst durch eine selbständige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise und bringst Leistungsbereitschaft, Teamfähigkeit, Serviceorientierung sowie ein sicheres Auftreten mit.

Benefits

  • Du kannst dich auf ein Team freuen, das dir bei allen Fragen und Problemen zur Seite steht.
  • Dein berufliches Weiterkommen liegt uns am Herzen: Deshalb unterstützen wir deine Wünsche nach Fort- und Weiterbildungen.
  • Darüber hinaus fördern wir bei Interesse die zielgerichtete Weiterbildung, wie beispielsweise den Erwerb von Berufsexamina.
  • Du kannst bei uns vor Ort oder im Homeoffice arbeiten.
  • Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Familien unterstützt. Wenn du dich um deine Kinder krankheitsbedingt kümmern musst, zahlen wir dir bis zu fünf Tage im Jahr das volle Gehalt.
  • Jedes Jahr laden wir Dich zu Festen, Ausflügen und Veranstaltungen ein.

Weitere Informationen über unsere Tätigkeiten für Mandanten aus dem öffentlichen Verkehrssektor findest du auf unserer Website.

Die Inklusion von Menschen mit Behinderung entspricht unserem Selbstverständnis und wir begrüßen daher deine Bewerbung.

jobs.title: Senior Process Engieer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of
lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming
the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a
cleaner and more innovative future.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the
design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes.
This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering,
and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into
robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our
future plants are built on solid fundamentals.
Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite
and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external
engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with:
a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development.
We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production
environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is
telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales.


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

Must Have's:
1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up
● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants.
● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process
descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions.

● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design
criteria and scale-up assumptions.
● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future
plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than
theoretical assumptions alone.
2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization
● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps.
● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of
graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing.
● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and
translate these insights into concrete process improvements.
● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on
process performance and technology development rather than daily
troubleshooting.
3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling
● Turn plant data into engineering decisions.
● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances
and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process
performance.
● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions.
● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure
that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality.
● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and
future plant designs.
4. Commissioning & Process Validation
● Make sure what we designed actually works.
● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance
validation for new equipment and plant expansions.
● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original
design intent.
● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed
systems achieve their calculated performance targets.
● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership
transfers once the process meets its design criteria.
5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs
● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently.
● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation.
● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews,
ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather
than after installation.
● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process
parameters of newly commissioned systems.

Nice-to-have's:
Vendor & EPC Coordination
● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners
and equipment suppliers.
● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering
documentation.
● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and
ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process.
● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process
performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability.
● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and
equipment vendors throughout project execution.


Your profile

You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving
technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and
real plant data.
● Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Metallurgical
Engineering or a related technical field.
● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical,
hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process
industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and
post-processing is highly preferred.
● Strong experience with process design and scale-up, including PFDs, P&IDs,
mass/energy balances and equipment sizing.
● Comfortable working with industrial datasets and translating operational data
into engineering models and decisions.
● Experience with solid-liquid separation, precipitation, flotation,
hydrometallurgy or mineral processing is highly valuable.
● Able to critically review vendor proposals and confidently challenge technical
assumptions.
● Strong experience supporting commissioning and process validation of
industrial equipment or plants.
● Familiarity with process safety methodologies such as HAZOP and LOPA.
● Comfortable moving between detailed calculations, engineering
documentation and the actual plant.
● Strong communicator who can work effectively across R&D, Engineering,
Operations, suppliers and EPC partners.
● Fluent English; German is a plus.


Why us?

Our technology is moving from first-of-a-kind industrial operations toward
increasingly larger and more standardized plants.
The Senior Process Engineer will help us make that transition successfully: turning
what we learn from today's plant into the engineering basis for tomorrow's plants
while supporting commissioning and ramping up efforts.
You will directly influence process performance, equipment selection, CAPEX and the
technical architecture of our future facilities — helping ensure that every new scale is
safer, simpler, more efficient and better engineered than the one before it.

jobs.title: Account Executive – Full-Cycle, New Business (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
THE JOB

Reading this to the end is worth it.

The Company: Why mute-labs?


mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We are self-funded, profitable since day one, and have no investors to answer to and no exit to chase. What we do have is a steep growth curve in revenue, a product made in Germany, and a genuine mission: giving the modern office some quiet back.


We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you.


Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires.


The Role: Build the Pipeline AND the Channel


This is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing.


  • Green Field, Full Ownership: Build your own pipeline from scratch. There is no inherited book of business and no recycled leads. The customer base you build is yours, and so is the revenue you generate from it.

  • Your Stack, Your Sequences: Clay, Reply.io, LinkedIn Premium, and Aircall are all at your disposal. You design your own outreach sequences, run your own cold calling campaigns, and decide how the machine works. Nobody hands you a script.

  • Segment Strategy, Together: You understand the market as well as anyone. Rather than being handed a target list from above, you and your manager will decide together which segments and account types are worth focusing on.

  • Comp That Rewards More Than the First Deal: An uncapped bonus with a kicker for overperformance. Returning customers you bring in keep feeding your comp over time, not just the initial close. Landing an account well is worth more than landing it once.

  • A Brand That Opens Doors: You are not cold-calling on behalf of an unknown startup. mute-labs is an established, well-regarded market leader with a reference list that already includes some of the biggest names in German and European business. That credibility is yours to use from day one.

  • A seasoned team to back you up: Your manager has built and run outbound and enterprise sales hands-on, from cold pipeline to six-figure closes, and will work closely with you from day one, coaching, supporting, and training wherever it's actually needed rather than just checking in on numbers.


Is This You?


  • The Go-Getter: You do not wait to be told what to do next. You get on your feet quickly, figure out the shape of the problem, and start moving before anyone has to push you.

  • Sales Experience: You have carried a full sales cycle before, from first contact to signed contract, and know how to keep a deal moving without needing someone else to close it for you. You do not need to have sold into large enterprises already, that is something you will grow into here.

  • Stakeholder Management: You know how to work a deal with more than one person in the room, decision-makers, influencers, and budget holders, and you can keep several of those relationships moving in parallel without losing the thread.

  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: There is no existing playbook to inherit here. You will help write it. If you need every process defined for you before you can start, this is not the role.

  • Fluent in German and English: Most of your target accounts are DACH-based, though the reference list extends across the EU. Strong German is expected; English is the internal working language.


Our Hiring Process


We keep this fast and honest, on both sides.


  1. The Spark: A short intro call with our People team to check for basic fit.

  2. The deepdive: A conversation with your future manager Patrick about your experience, how you build your pipeline and how you close. Here you’ll also meet the rest of the team.

  3. The Live Action: A live discovery or negotiation role-play based on a realistic enterprise scenario. No prep deck, just show us how you actually work a deal.

  4. The Vision: A final conversation with Leah, Head of Sales as well as Franziskus, Managing Director, on the strategic mandate behind this role and where it can go from here.


ABOUT US

mute-labs exists to make quiet a normal part of the modern workplace. A few things that set us apart:


  • We are "no tech": we build and sell real hardware, sound-insulated phone and meeting booths that companies actually need.

  • We have no investors, and we are not looking for any. We have been profitable since day one.

  • We are on a steep growth curve, measured in revenue and profit, not headcount for its own sake.

  • We are not building toward an exit. We are building a company meant to last for generations.



Skip the Queue

Told you it was worth reading to the end.


We are looking for someone with a go-getter attitude who does not wait around for permission. So here is your first test: don't apply through the form. Cold call your future manager, Patrick, directly.


+49 15888 279908


If you get through and make your case, you've already shown us more than any CV could.

From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

Our mission is to provide cheaper, greener energy to the French market.

Kraken technologies

 

Kraken Technologies is a company within Octopus Energy Group who are licensing the Kraken platform and operating model to clients across the world. All technology is written and maintained by a multi-discipline engineering team of around 450 people globally. This includes server-side, client-side and mobile engineers working closely with UX experts, copywriters and designers.

Octopus is a great place to learn, work with some talented engineers and level-up your skills.

 

Our technology

 

On the server-side, we mainly use Python. Most of our websites are powered by Django and the Django-REST-framework. We also use Pandas, Numpy and Jupyter for analysis and forecasting, plus Celery, RabbitMQ, SQS and Airflow for background processing.

Client-side, we use React, Redux and SASS; our mobile apps are built using native code or React Native.

About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission

As a Customer Value Partner at Hawk, you own the customer relationship from first scoping through implementation and into ongoing growth: one name, one accountable owner, no handoffs between a CSM, an Engagement Manager, and a PM along the way. You run delivery according to Hawk's best practices and methodology, and you're judged on whether the customer hits the outcomes we promised. At the core of the role is understanding what value actually means for each customer, in their own numbers, against their own objectives, and then building it, not reporting on it after the fact. You're not a project manager who bends to every customer's internal governance model. You're the person who proves the value Hawk delivers, then converts that proof into retained and expanded revenue.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full customer lifecycle for your portfolio, from initial scoping and implementation through to ongoing value realization, adoption, and new use cases. There's no relay handoff here; you carry the account start to finish.

  • Manage delivery according to Hawk's best practices and methodology: build the plan, track progress against it, and report clearly. Lightweight project management, owned by us.

  • Understand what value truly means for each customer, in their own numbers, and then build it. Design and drive joint success plans that align Hawk's delivery to each client's real business objectives and regulatory context, not a generic template.

  • Own commercial outcomes: drive GRR and NRR for your accounts, and where contract terms carry revenue contingency, own that recognition outcome too.

  • You're not negotiating deal terms, but you're building and proving the confidence that gets deals signed and renewed.

  • Monitor usage and performance relentlessly, and turn what you find into optimization work: false positives down, analyst hours back, faster investigations. These are numbers customers see in their own systems, not numbers we tell them about.

  • Bring AI and agentic AI tools and techniques into how you manage your customers: faster QBR prep, sharper account insight, more consistent reporting, so your time goes to judgement and relationships, not manual admin.

  • Work the sales cycle as a credibility engine, not a seller. You get pulled into pre-sale conversations to build confidence that Hawk can actually deliver what's being promised, backed by your own track record of having done it, and you're the SME customers turn to for end-to-end value creation and enablement with Hawk's technology.

  • Build and defend executive relationships across the account, from governance calls to QBRs, so that Hawk's value is something the customer's leadership sees and states in their own words, not something we have to convince them of every quarter.

Your Profile

  • 5+ years in customer-facing roles spanning some combination of customer success, engagement management, or delivery/project management within B2B enterprise software. This role consolidates all three, so breadth across them matters more than a title match.

  • A real track record managing accounts at €500K+ ARR, including cross-sell or expansion work you can point to and explain, not just accounts you kept alive.

  • Comfortable owning a delivery plan end to end, scoping, tracking, and reporting, using Hawk's best practices and methodology, without needing a separate PM in the room to keep things on track.

  • Strong grasp of SaaS and enterprise software delivery models; experience in AML, fraud prevention, or another regulated financial services domain is a real advantage, not a nice-to-have footnote.

  • Hands-on comfort with AI and agentic AI tools and techniques, and you actually use them, to work faster, sharpen your analysis, and raise the quality of what you deliver to customers, not just aware that they exist.

  • Genuine comfort operating at C-suite level. You can run a governance call with a customer's leadership team and hold your own, translating delivery status into a conversation executives actually want to have.

  • A bias toward ownership over process. You understand what value actually means for a customer, not just what the contract says, and you close the gap yourself rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Experience in, or real appetite for, a start-up or scale-up environment where the account model is still being built as you go, not a fully mature playbook you're just executing.

Bonus

  • Another language relevant to Hawk's EMEA customer base, in addition to fluent English.

  • Prior experience where you personally carried both the commercial number (GRR/NRR) and the delivery outcome for the same account, rather than one or the other

Mimica is growing fast, and so is the demand on our Platform Team. As a DevOps / Platform Engineer, you will join a lean but highly capable team that is the backbone of every engineering squad in the company.

We service the entire engineering organisation: keeping environments healthy, unblocking teams, and building the infrastructure that lets everyone else move faster. We’re looking to increase our capacity as demand for our services is growing fast.

This means the work is varied: one day you are debugging an RBAC issue in production, the next you are designing a multi-cloud access pattern from scratch.

We are looking for engineers with either an application development or a systems/infrastructure background.

  • Investigate and triage issues in existing applications, observe database and system component health, and implement changes to support the SDLC of other teams.

  • Participate in a scheduled on-call rotation to monitor system health, respond to incidents, and ensure high platform availability.

  • Contribute to migrating our IaC layer from Terraform to Crossplane and support expansion into multi-region clusters and single-tenancy environments.

  • Drive FinOps initiatives, helping us get visibility into and control over cloud spend across multiple accounts and environments.

  • Help design and implement access patterns for new BYOC and single-tenancy environments, making it seamless for engineers to navigate an increasingly complex multi-environment landscape.

  • Instrument, monitor, and improve observability across our stack using tools such as Honeycomb and Grafana.

 

Requirements / What we're looking for

  • Solid hands-on experience with Kubernetes, whether on GKE (preferred), EKS, OnPrem, or another managed Kubernetes service. You know your way around cluster configuration, scheduling, RBAC, and debugging live issues.

  • Proven experience with Terraform as your primary IaC tool. Familiarity with Terragrunt is a plus.

  • IAM and identity management experience on at least one major hyperscaler: GCP (preferred) or AWS.

  • Experience with ArgoCD or a comparable GitOps tool for continuous delivery.

  • Observability experience with at least one major platform: Honeycomb, Datadog, Grafana, or New Relic. You know how to set up meaningful dashboards, alerts, and traces.

  • Comfortable writing code, particularly Python, to automate platform tasks and build internal tooling.

  • Background in startups or scale-ups: you are used to ambiguity, moving fast, and wearing multiple hats.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills: You can translate infrastructure complexity into clear language for application engineers, and you know when to raise a flag versus just fixing it.

  • Experience leading and participating in incident responses. You systematically decompose problems and know how to get to the root cause without panicking.

 

Bonus / Nice to have

  • Experience running GPU workloads on Kubernetes, particularly in the context of ML infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with Crossplane (or strong interest in migrating to it from Terraform).

  • Experience with Temporal for workflow orchestration.

  • Hands-on knowledge of Grafana Alloy, Loki, or similar observability tooling in the Grafana ecosystem.

  • Experience with MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.

  • Security engineering experience, particularly around hardening Kubernetes environments or supporting compliance initiatives (e.g. SOC 2).

Hiring process

Our process is designed to be practical and respectful of your time. We want to see how you think, not just what you know.

  1. Recruiter Screen (30–45 min) - A conversation with our Talent Partner to explore your background, motivations, and culture fit.

  2. Live Technical Challenge: Triage & Debug (1 h) - A hands-on live challenge with the Hiring Manager and a member of the team.

  3. System Design Interview (1h) - A live session focused on infrastructure design: we will walk through a real architectural problem and discuss trade-offs.

  4. Behavioural Interview (60 min) - A deeper conversation with the Engineering Manager for Platform and our Co-founder & CTO.

  5. Offer & Identity Verification
